jobs.title: Speech to Text Audio Collection - Malay Speakers
jobs.excerpt: TELUS Digital is seeking Malay speakers to participate in a Speech-to-Text (STT) audio collection project.
jobs.description:
TELUS Digital is seeking Malay speakers to participate in a Speech-to-Text (STT) audio collection project. Participants will record voice utterances by reading provided scripts in Malay English (Manglish) using our mobile or web application. During multiple recording sessions, you will receive scripts covering various everyday conversational topics and read them naturally and conversationally—avoiding overly formal or robotic speech patterns.

The Primary Objective

The primary objective of this project is to create high-quality audio recordings paired with corresponding scripts to train and improve speech recognition models. Your participation helps develop speech recognition technology that understands and processes natural speech, ultimately enhancing AI systems and user experience.

Expected Project Duration

July 2026 – September 2026

Time to Complete the Task

10–20 hours

Location

Remote

Qualification path

Payment Rate:

  • $5 USD per 1 hour of completed task.

  • This is an Independent Contractor opportunity.

  • Payments will be made via Hyperwallet, where you can choose PayPal or Bank Transfer as the payment method.

Other Requirements:

  • Fluent Malay Speaker

  • English Proficiency

  • 12–60+ years old

  • A device with a microphone (phone, tablet, PC, or laptop)

  • Stable internet connection for the duration of the task

  • Each participant can only complete the project once

jobs.title: Media Search Analyst - English (AU)
jobs.excerpt: Job description Ready to say goodbye to the boring, traditional 9-5 routine and embrace a dynamic and exciting work environment that puts you in control?
jobs.description:
Job description

Ready to say goodbye to the boring, traditional 9-5 routine and embrace a dynamic and exciting work environment that puts you in control? This position offers you the flexibility to set your own schedule and complete exciting tasks using an innovative web-based evaluation tool.

A Day in the Life of a Media Search Analyst:

  • In this role, you will be doing a comprehensive assessment of diverse task categories, encompassing music, video, and home pod evaluations spanning various media domains

  • Analyzing and evaluating search outcomes for App Store Content and conducting research using online tools to assess and validate query accuracy and intent by applying market expertise in conjunction with provided directives to evaluate the relevance and purpose of task-related information for your specific market.


Join us today and be a key player in our community revolutionizing digital media content!

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.

Basic Requirements

  • Full Professional Proficiency in the English language

  • Being a resident in Australia for the last year consecutively and having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Australia

  • Having an email address associated with an Apple ID and experience and know-how of Apple products

  • Having up-to-date familiarity with prevailing trends in applications, music & video with a keen interest in internet research

  • Flexibility to work across a diverse set of task types

  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, computer, and relevant software

  • Independent working and the ability to adapt to innovative methodologies and processes with great attention to detail and exceptional communication skills

  • While a High School degree or higher certification is preferred, we are open to candidates with exceptional skills and talent.

  • Additional Incentives provided throughout the assessment process

 

Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your qualification exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience.

Apply Here:

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

jobs.excerpt: চাকরির বিবরণ আপনি কি বিস্তারিত বিষয়ে মনোযোগী ব্যক্তি যার গবেষণার প্রতি আবেগ এবং জাতীয় এবং স্থানীয় ভূগোলের ভালো বোঝাপড়া আছে?
jobs.description:
চাকরির বিবরণ

আপনি কি বিস্তারিত বিষয়ে মনোযোগী ব্যক্তি যার গবেষণার প্রতি আবেগ এবং জাতীয় এবং স্থানীয় ভূগোলের ভালো বোঝাপড়া আছে? এই ফ্রিল্যান্স সুযোগ আপনাকে নিজের গতিতে এবং নিজের বাড়ির আরামে কাজ করতে দেয়।

একজন অনলাইন ডেটা বিশ্লেষকের একটি দিন:

  • এই ভূমিকায়, আপনি একটি প্রকল্পে কাজ করবেন যা বিশ্বব্যাপী লক্ষ লক্ষ মানুষ দ্বারা ব্যবহৃত ডিজিটাল মানচিত্রের বিষয়বস্তু এবং গুণমান উন্নত করার লক্ষ্যে রয়েছে।

  • ওয়েব-ভিত্তিক পরিবেশে গবেষণা এবং মূল্যায়ন কাজ সম্পন্ন করা যেমন ডেটা যাচাই এবং তুলনা করা, এবং তথ্যের প্রাসঙ্গিকতা ও নির্ভুলতা নির্ধারণ করা।

আজই আমাদের সাথে যোগ দিন এবং একটি গতিশীল এবং উদ্ভাবনী দলের অংশ হন যা বিশ্বে পরিবর্তন আনছে!

TELUS Digital AI Community

আমাদের বৈশ্বিক AI কমিউনিটি হলো বিভিন্ন পটভূমির দশ লক্ষেরও বেশি অবদানকারীর একটি প্রাণবন্ত নেটওয়ার্ক। তাঁরা গ্রাহকদের উন্নতমানের AI মডেল তৈরির লক্ষ্যে কন্টেন্ট সংগ্রহ, পরিমার্জন, প্রশিক্ষণ, অনুবাদ এবং স্থানীয়করণের কাজে সহায়তা করেন। আমাদের ক্রমবর্ধমান এই কমিউনিটির অংশ হোন এবং বিশ্বের শীর্ষস্থানীয় কিছু ব্র্যান্ডের ব্যবহৃত উদ্ভাবনী AI প্রযুক্তির উন্নয়নে অবদান রাখুন।

যোগ্যতার পথ

এই ভূমিকায় আবেদন করার জন্য কোন পূর্ববর্তী পেশাদার অভিজ্ঞতার প্রয়োজন নেই, তবে এই প্রকল্পে কাজ করার জন্য আপনাকে মৌলিক প্রয়োজনীয়তাগুলি পূরণ করতে এবং একটি মান মূল্যায়ন প্রক্রিয়ার মধ্য দিয়ে যেতে হবে। এটি একটি অংশ-সময়ের দীর্ঘমেয়াদী প্রকল্প এবং আপনার কাজ এই চুক্তির শর্তাবলীতে আমাদের মান গুণমান নিশ্চিতকরণ পরীক্ষার সাপেক্ষে থাকবে।

মৌলিক প্রয়োজনীয়তা

  • বাংলা এবং ইংরেজি ভাষায় সম্পূর্ণ পেশাদার দক্ষতা

  • গত ৫ বছর ধরে ভারতের বাসিন্দা থাকা এবং ভারতের বর্তমান এবং ঐতিহাসিক ব্যবসা, মিডিয়া, ক্রীড়া, সংবাদ, সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া এবং সাংস্কৃতিক বিষয়ে পরিচিত থাকা

  • নির্দেশিকা অনুসরণ করার এবং সার্চ ইঞ্জিন, অনলাইন মানচিত্র এবং ওয়েবসাইট তথ্য ব্যবহার করে অনলাইন গবেষণা পরিচালনা করার ক্ষমতা

  • মানচিত্র, সংবাদ, অডিও কাজ এবং প্রাসঙ্গিকতা সহ বিভিন্ন ধরনের কাজ জুড়ে কাজ করার নমনীয়তা

  • প্রতিদিন ব্রডব্যান্ড ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ, কম্পিউটার এবং প্রাসঙ্গিক সফটওয়্যার অ্যাক্সেস

মূল্যায়ন

প্রোগ্রামে নিয়োগ করার জন্য, আপনি একটি খোলা বই যোগ্যতা পরীক্ষা নেবেন যা আপনার এই অবস্থানের জন্য উপযুক্ততা নির্ধারণ করবে এবং আইডি যাচাইকরণ সম্পন্ন করবেন। আমাদের দল আপনার যোগ্যতা পরীক্ষার আগে নির্দেশিকা এবং শেখার উপকরণ প্রদান করবে। আপনাকে নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে পরীক্ষা সম্পন্ন করতে হবে কিন্তু আপনার সুবিধা অনুযায়ী।


এখানে আবেদন করুন:

স্বাধীন ঠিকাদার সম্পর্ক

এই সুযোগটি একজন স্বতন্ত্র ঠিকাদার (independent contractor) হিসেবে কাজ করার ভিত্তিতে প্রদান করা হচ্ছে। প্রকল্পের প্রাপ্যতা ও গুণগত মানের শর্ত সাপেক্ষে, অবদানকারীরা কখন এবং কতটা কাজ করবেন, তা নির্ধারণ করার স্বাধীনতা তাদের রয়েছে। এই সুযোগটিকে TELUS Digital-এর সাথে কোনো কর্মসংস্থান বা চাকরির সম্পর্ক হিসেবে গণ্য করা যাবে না।

jobs.description:
Job description

Are you a detail-oriented individual with a passion for research and a good understanding of national and local geography? This freelance opportunity allows you to work at your own pace and from the comfort of your own home.

 

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst:

  • In this role, you will be working on a project aimed at enhancing the content and quality of digital maps that are used by millions of people worldwide

  • Completing research and evaluation tasks in a web-based environment such as verifying and comparing data, and determining the relevance and accuracy of information.

 

Join us today and be part of a dynamic and innovative team that is making a difference in the world!

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Full Professional Proficiency in English language

  • Being a resident in Australia for the last 5 consecutive years and having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Australia.

  • Ability to follow guidelines and conduct online research using search engines, online maps, and website information

  • Flexibility to work across a diverse set of task types, including maps, news, audio tasks, and relevance

  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, computer, and relevant software

 

Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your qualification exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience.

Apply Here:

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

jobs.excerpt: ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ವಿವರಣೆ ನೀವು ವಿವರಗಳಿಗೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೇ, ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಗಾಧ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕತೆಯ ಉತ್ತಮ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ?
jobs.description:
ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ವಿವರಣೆ

ನೀವು ವಿವರಗಳಿಗೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೇ, ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಗಾಧ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕತೆಯ ಉತ್ತಮ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ? ಈ ಫ್ರೀಲ್ಯಾನ್ಸ್ ಅವಕಾಶವು ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ವಂತ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಘರದ ಸುವಿಧೆಯಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ಅನುಮತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಡೇಟಾ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಕನ ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ದಿನ:

  • ಈ ಪಾತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ನೀವು ವಿಶ್ವಾದ್ಯಂತ ಲಕ್ಷಲಕ್ಷ ಜನರು ಬಳಸುವ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ವಿಷಯವಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಗುಣಮಾನವನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸುವ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವಿರಿ.

  • ವೆಬ್-ಆಧಾರಿತ ಪರಿಸರದಲ್ಲಿ ಡೇಟಾ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮತ್ತು ತುಲನೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಾಸಂಗಿಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಖುರತೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವುದುಹೀಗಿನ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು.

ಇಂದು ನಮ್ಮೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಆನುವುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಶೀಲ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಭಾವನೀ ಹೃದಯದ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರಿ!

TELUS Digital AI Community

ನಮ್ಮ ಜಾಗತಿಕ AI ಸಮುದಾಯವು ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಗಳಿರುವ ಹತ್ತು ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೊಡುಗೆದಾರರ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರಿಯಾಶೀಲ ಜಾಲವಾಗಿದೆ. ಉತ್ತಮ AI ಮಾದರಿಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಿರುವ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು (content) ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು, ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸಲು, ತರಬೇತಿ ನೀಡಲು, ಅನುವಾದಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳೀಯಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಇವರು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಮುದಾಯದ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವದ ಕೆಲವು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಗಳು ಬಳಸುವ ನವೀನ AI ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನಗಳ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೊಡುಗೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಿ.

ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಹಾದಿ

ಈ ಪಾತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ಹಿಂದಿನ ವೃತ್ತಿಮಾನ ಅನುಭವದ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದಾಗ್ಯೂ ಈ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ನೀವು ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಮೂಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೋಗಬೇಕು. ಇದು ಒಂದು ಅರ್ಧ-ಸಮಯದ ದೀರ್ಘಾವಧಿಯ ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸವು ಈ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಖಚಿತ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳು

  • ಕನ್ನಡ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಗ್ರಜಿ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವೃತ್ತಿಮಾನ ನಿಪುಣತೆ

  • ಕಳೆದ 5 ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿವಾಸಿ ಆಗಿರುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಮತ್ತು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ, ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ, ಸುದ್ದಿ, ಸೋಶ್ಯಲ್ ಮೀಡಿಯಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಚಯವಿರುವುದು

  • ಮಾರ್ಗನಿರ್ದೇಶನಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಚ್ ಇಂಜಿನ್‌ಗಳು, ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಬಳಸಿ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ನಡೆಸಲು ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ

  • ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳು, ಸುದ್ದಿ, ಆಡಿಯೋ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತತೆ ಸಹ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳಾದ್ಯಂತ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ನಮ್ಯತೆ

  • ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಬ್যಾಂಡ್ ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ, ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್‌ಗೆ ದೈನಿಕ ಪ್ರವೇಶ

ಮೂಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ

ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಯೋಜಿತರಾಗುವುದಕ್ಕೆ, ನೀವು ಒಂದು ಓಪನ್ ಬುಕ್ ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೀರಿ ಅದು ಆ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಐಡಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ನಮ್ಮ ತಂಡವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಯೋಗ್ಯತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಮಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗನಿರ್ದೇಶನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಲನೆ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿಯನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀವು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಸಮಯ ಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಿದ್ದು ಆದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅನುಕೂಲಕ್ಕೆ.

ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ:

ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಗುತ್ತಿಗೆದಾರರ ಸಂಬಂಧ

ಈ ಅವಕಾಶವನ್ನು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಗುತ್ತಿಗೆದಾರರ (independent contractor) ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಲಭ್ಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟದ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಳಪಟ್ಟು, ತಾವು ಯಾವಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಮಯ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯವು ಕೊಡುಗೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಅವಕಾಶವು TELUS Digital ಜೊತೆಗಿನ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಇದನ್ನು ಹಾಗೆ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬಾರದು.

jobs.description:
Job description

ଆପଣ କଣ ଗବେଷଣା ପ୍ରତି ଆଗ୍ରହୀ ଏବଂ ଜାତୀୟ ଓ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଭୂଗୋଳ ବିଷୟରେ ଭଲ ଧାରଣା ରଖୁଥିବା ଜଣେ ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମଦର୍ଶୀ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି? ଏହି ଫ୍ରିଲାନ୍ସ ଅବସର ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ନିଜ ଗତିରେ ଏବଂ ଘରରୁ କାମ କରିବା ସୁଯୋଗ ଦେଉଛି।

 

ଏକ ଅନଲାଇନ୍ ଡାଟା ବିଶ୍ଳେଷକଙ୍କର ଜୀବନରେ ଏକ ଦିନ:

  • ଏହି ଭୂମିକାରେ ଆପଣ ଏକ ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ଉପରେ କାମ କରିବେ ଯାହା ବିଶ୍ୱବ୍ୟାପୀ ଲୋକମାନେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିବା ଡିଜିଟାଲ୍ ମାନଚିତ୍ରଗୁଡ଼ିକର ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ଓ ଗୁଣଉନ୍ନତି ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବା ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟରେ ଥିବ।

  •  ୱେବ୍ ଆଧାରିତ ପରିବେଶରେ ଗବେଷଣା ଓ ମୂଲ୍ୟାୟନ କରିବା, ଯଥା ତଥ୍ୟ ସତ୍ୟାପନ, ତୁଳନା, ଏବଂ ତଥ୍ୟର ସଠିକତା ଓ ସମ୍ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗିକତା ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରିବା।

 

ଆଜି ଆମ ସହିତ ଯୋଗ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ବିଶ୍ୱରେ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଆଣୁଥିବା ଏକ ଗତିଶୀଳ ଓ ନବପ୍ରଯୁକ୍ତିମୂଳକ ଦଳର ଅଂଶ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ!

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

ଆମର ବିଶ୍ୱସ୍ତରୀୟ AI ସମ୍ପ୍ରଦାୟ ହେଉଛି ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପୃଷ୍ଠଭୂମିର ଦଶ ଲକ୍ଷରୁ ଅଧିକ ଅବଦାନକାରୀଙ୍କର ଏକ ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନଶୀଳ ନେଟୱାର୍କ, ଯେଉଁମାନେ ଗ୍ରାହକମାନଙ୍କୁ ଉନ୍ନତ AI ମଡେଲ ନିର୍ମାଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ସଂଗ୍ରହ, ବୃଦ୍ଧି, ତାଲିମ, ଅନୁବାଦ ଏବଂ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟକରଣ କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରନ୍ତି। ଆମର ବର୍ଦ୍ଧିତ ସମ୍ପ୍ରଦାୟର ଅଂଶ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ବିଶ୍ୱର କିଛି ବୃହତ ବ୍ରାଣ୍ଡ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଅଭିନବ AI ପ୍ରଯୁକ୍ତିବିଦ୍ୟାର ବିକାଶରେ ଯୋଗଦାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

Qualification path

ଯୋଗ୍ୟତା:

ଏହି ଭୂମିକା ପାଇଁ ଆବେଦନ କରିବାକୁ ପୂର୍ବ ଅନୁଭବର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ନାହିଁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଏହି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ଉପରେ କାମ କରିବାକୁ ମୌଳିକ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ପୂରଣ କରିବା ଏବଂ ଏକ ମାନକ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଯିବା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ। ଏହା ଏକ ଅଂଶକାଳୀନ ଦୀର୍ଘ ଅବଧି ଯୁକ୍ତ ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ଓ ଆପଣଙ୍କ କାମ ଏହି ଚୁକ୍ତିର ସମୟସୀମାରେ ଗୁଣମାନ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ପରୀକ୍ଷାର ଅଧୀନରେ ରହିବ।

 

ମୌଳିକ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା:

  • ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଭାଷାରେ ପାଠନ ଓ ଲେଖନରେ ପରଙ୍ଗମତା ଏବଂ ଇଂରାଜୀ ଭାଷାରେ ମୌଳିକ ପାରଙ୍ଗମତା


  • ଗତ 5 ବର୍ଷ ଧରି ଭାରତରେ ରହୁଥିବା ଏବଂ ଭାରତୀୟ ବ୍ୟବସାୟ, ଗଣମାଧ୍ୟମ, କ୍ରୀଡା, ସମାଚାର, ସାମାଜିକ ଗଣମାଧ୍ୟମ ଏବଂ ସାଂସ୍କୃତିକ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ବିଷୟରେ ଜ୍ଞାନୀ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି

  • ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶନାମାନଙ୍କୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରିବା ଓ ସର୍ଚ ଇଞ୍ଜିନ, ମାନଚିତ୍ର, ୱେବସାଇଟ ଆଧାରିତ ସୂଚନା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଅନଲାଇନ୍ ଗବେଷଣା କରିବା 

  • ମାନଚିତ୍ର, ସମ୍ବାଦ, ଧ୍ୱନି ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ କାମ, ରିଲେଭାନ୍ସ ଭଳି ଭିନ୍ନ-ଭିନ୍ନ ଧରଣର କାମ ସହ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବାର କ୍ଷମତା 

  • ଦୈନିକ broadband ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ସଂଯୋଗ, କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ଓ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ସଫ୍ଟୱେର ର ପହଞ୍ଚ

 

ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ:

କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ ଚୟନ ପାଇଁ ଆପଣ ଏକ ଖୋଲା ପୁସ୍ତକ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ଦେବେ ଯାହା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଯୋଗ୍ୟତା ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରିବ। ଏହା ସହିତ ପରିଚୟ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ମଧ୍ୟ କରିବେ। ଆମ ଦଳ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଯୋଗ୍ୟତା ପରୀକ୍ଷା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ଓ ଶିକ୍ଷାନୈତିକ ସାମଗ୍ରୀ ଯୋଗାଇ ଦେବ। ଆପଣ ଏହି ପରୀକ୍ଷା ଏକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସମୟସୀମା ମଧ୍ୟରେ କିନ୍ତୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସୁବିଧା ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ଦେବେ।

jobs.title: Technical weclapp Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Bei den meisten ERP-Projekten endet die Beratung dort, wo die Technik anfängt – bei uns nicht.
jobs.description:
Bei den meisten ERP-Projekten endet die Beratung dort, wo die Technik anfängt – bei uns nicht. Als Technical weclapp Consultant (m/w/d) wirst du Teil unseres Consulting-Teams und betreust gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen unsere E-Commerce-Kund:innen rund um weclapp – nah genug am Code, um kleinere Dinge selbst umzusetzen und größere Themen strukturiert ans Dev-Team zu geben. Diese Mischung aus Beratung, Technik und KI-gestütztem Arbeiten macht die Rolle bei uns besonders: Wir reichen Anforderungen nicht weiter – wir lösen sie gemeinsam.

Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen über den weclapp-Lebenszyklus – beim Onboarding, der Implementierung und im laufenden Support.
  • Du hältst fachliche Anforderungen sauber fest, dokumentierst sie strukturiert und bringst sie ins Development-Team ein.
  • Du konfigurierst weclapp entlang gängiger E-Commerce-Prozesse und abgestimmter Vorgaben.
  • Du setzt kleinere Automatisierungen und Anpassungen selbst um – z.B. n8n-Flows, API-Calls oder Datenimporte und -mappings – und ziehst bei Komplexerem das Dev-Team hinzu.
  • Du unterstützt das Dev-Team bei der Umsetzung von Lösungen und SaaS-Plugins für weclapp.
  • Du führst Onboarding-Schulungen durch, erstellst Dokumentationen und hilfst Teams, ihr weclapp-System sicher zu nutzen.
  • Du analysierst Support- und Schnittstellenfälle (Shop, Marktplatz, Payment, Carrier wie DPD, Sendcloud oder Shipcloud), findest die Ursache und bringst sie zur Lösung.

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • Solide weclapp-Kenntnisse und erste Praxiserfahrung – ob aus einer Consultant-, Inhouse- oder Support-Rolle im E-Commerce.
  • Gutes ERP-Prozessverständnis (Order-to-Cash, Purchase-to-Pay, Stammdaten, Workflows) und Grundkenntnisse in Buchhaltung/Finance.
  • Technisches Grundverständnis mit Hands-on-Touch: Du liest APIs und Datenstrukturen, verstehst Automatisierungen und baust kleinere Flows oder Skripte selbst (z.B. n8n, REST/JSON).
  • Offenheit für KI-gestütztes Arbeiten: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools (z.B. LLMs/Assistenten) aktiv im Alltag und willst mehr daraus machen.
  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise: Du hörst gut zu, fragst sauber nach und dokumentierst klar.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- UND Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Wohnsitz und Anstellung in Österreich oder Deutschland; Arbeit fully remote.

Nice-to-have

  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit der weclapp-API, Schnittstellen, Datenimporten oder Automatisierungen.
  • Erste Programmiererfahrung mit JavaScript (Node.js/Vue.js) oder Python.
  • Interesse an oder erste Berührung mit MCP/generativer KI.
  • Verständnis des E-Commerce-Stacks: Shop-Systeme (z.B. Shopify), Marktplätze, WMS (z.B. Pulpo WMS), Versand/Carrier.
  • Erfahrung in Schulung/Enablement (Trainings, Dokus, Guidelines).

Benefits

  • 🏡 Fully Remote in DE/AT – keine Präsenzpflicht. Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist.
  • 🕒 Teilzeit oder Vollzeit – echte Wahl von 30 bis 38,5 Std./Woche, passend zu deinem Leben, nicht umgekehrt.
  • 🔀 Die seltene Kombi aus Beratung + Hands-on-Technik in einer Rolle – mit kurzem Draht zum Dev-Team und zum Produkt.
  • 💻 Moderne Ausstattung: Apple MacBook + alles, was du für produktives Remote-Work brauchst.
  • 🌱 Wachstumsmarkt & technische Nähe: weclapp + E-Commerce + Hyperautomation (n8n, MCP, generative KI) – neue Use-Cases statt Routine.
  • 🧠 Flache Hierarchien & kurze Entscheidungswege: direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung – offen, ehrlich, ohne Konzernpolitik.

💶 Gehalt

Das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgrundgehalt nach österreichischem IT-KV beträgt für diese Stelle € 3.954 brutto/Monat auf Vollzeitbasis (Stand 2026, das entspricht € 55.356 brutto/Jahr), mit Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung. Bei Teilzeit erfolgt die Angabe aliquot zur Stundenanzahl. Für Bewerber:innen aus Deutschland dient dieser Wert als Orientierung – das konkrete Gehalt besprechen wir transparent je nach Erfahrung.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – CV plus ein paar Sätze, warum die Rolle zu dir passt (ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, eine Mail oder eine Nachricht über LinkedIn reichen völlig). Schick uns deine Unterlagen oder vernetz dich mit uns auf LinkedIn; deine Ansprechperson ist Markus Wals (Geschäftsführung).

So läuft’s weiter: kurzes Kennenlernen (30–60 Min.) → optionaler Praxis-/Tech-Deep-Dive aus unserem Alltag → faires, klares Angebot.

Bei uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Lernbereitschaft und dein Anspruch, Dinge sauber umzusetzen.

Herzliche Grüße und bis bald 😊

jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

About the role

As a Team Lead at Reserv, you will be a working leader providing support to a Claims manager with leadership and claim technical responsibilities. Leadership responsibilities will include overseeing work done within the Commercial Transportation Claims (trucking) adjusting staff. We want your background and experience to deliver operational effectiveness, particularly in leveraging technology and analytics to drive better efficiencies and performance. You will serve a critical role with the team, the customers, and the client. This role will balance management responsibilities and individual contributor responsibilities when volume dictates the need for assistance with a claim.

Who you are

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented, impactful and influential
  • Claims professional - you are knowledgeable and have a track record of success in commercial transportation claims adjudication.
  • Strong leader - through formal management experience or a proven track record of peer and project leadership, you have demonstrated the ability to motivate, support, and teach a team to help them excel in their roles.

  • Problem solver - You have the ability to take a ‘deep dive’ into the details of the business while staying focused on the big picture.

What we need

  • Flexibility - you will need to be able to switch from claims handling to coaching and feedback

Requirements

  • Active adjuster license required: resident state license if available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license
  • 3+ years of leadership experience with a preference for experience managing in a remote environment

  • Demonstrated commitment to quality, accuracy, and attention to detail

Benefits

Additionally, we will

At Reserv, we value diversity and believe that a variety of perspectives leads to innovation and success. jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Corporate Counsel and Risk Manager

Location: Remote (United States)

Job Summary

DLB is seeking an experienced Corporate Counsel and Risk Manager to lead enterprise risk management, contract and insurance risk oversight, and compliance governance across the organization. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining the firm's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, mitigated, and monitored in alignment with business objectives.

The successful candidate will provide strategic guidance on operational, contractual, regulatory, financial, and safety-related risks while partnering closely with executive leadership to support informed decision-making and sustainable growth. Working in conjunction with the Chief Legal Officer, this position also oversees risk-related contract review, insurance program administration, and enterprise compliance initiatives.

As a key member of the Operations Team, this role collaborates closely with Safety, Human Resources, Accounting, IT, Contract Administration, and Executive Leadership. The position reports directly to the Chief Legal Officer and requires strong business judgment, executive presence, and the ability to influence stakeholders in a fully remote environment.

This is a highly independent role responsible for leading complex projects, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and contributing to the development of organizational policies and procedures.

Essential Functions

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the firm's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework.
  • Conduct enterprise-wide risk assessments across operational, financial, contractual, regulatory, and safety-related functions.
  • Identify emerging risks associated with growth initiatives, geographic expansion, regulatory changes, and service diversification.
  • Analyze internal and external data, industry trends, and regulatory developments to evaluate organizational exposure.
  • Develop and monitor mitigation strategies and risk controls.
  • Establish risk tolerance thresholds, review standards, and escalation protocols.
  • Provide executive leadership with forward-looking risk analysis and recommendations.

Operational Risk and Safety Integration

  • Partner with Safety leadership to incorporate safety performance indicators into enterprise risk assessments.
  • Analyze incident, claims, near-miss, and compliance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Evaluate operational controls and recommend enhancements to strengthen organizational performance and resilience.
  • Support operational risk reviews, including virtual and onsite assessments as needed.
  • Ensure alignment between safety performance, project delivery objectives, and enterprise risk priorities.

Governance, Compliance, and Business Continuity

  • Develop and maintain corporate risk management and compliance policies.
  • Monitor adherence to regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.
  • Evaluate internal controls and identify compliance gaps or systemic weaknesses.
  • Participate in the Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Program and ensure continuity planning aligns with enterprise risk objectives.
  • Prepare risk reports and presentations for Executive Leadership and Board-level review.
  • Escalate material compliance issues and significant organizational risks as appropriate.

Contract and Insurance Risk Oversight

  • Review and assess contractual risk associated with client, vendor, consultant, technology, benefits, insurance, construction, design, product and manufacturing agreements.
  • Partner with the Contracts Team to evaluate high-risk contractual provisions and insurance requirements.
  • Lead administration of corporate insurance programs, including policy renewals, endorsements, coverage modifications, and claims management.
  • Coordinate with brokers, carriers, operations, and project teams to ensure appropriate risk transfer and insurance compliance.
  • Oversee certificates of insurance, subcontractor compliance, and client insurance requirements.
  • Monitor claims activity and emerging exposure trends and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
  • Support administration of company vehicle, travel, and driving-related risk programs.

Risk Reporting and Culture

  • Prepare executive-level dashboards, reports, and risk assessments.
  • Support organizational risk awareness and compliance training initiatives.
  • Conduct risk surveys and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Foster a proactive culture of accountability, compliance, safety, and risk awareness across the organization.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Position Requirements

Knowledge

Advanced knowledge of:

  • Enterprise risk management frameworks, governance models, and internal controls.
  • Contract and insurance law, and commercial risk allocation principles.
  • Auditing methodologies and compliance monitoring practices.
  • OSHA and multi-state regulatory requirements.
  • Insurance coverage structures and risk transfer strategies.
  • Business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  • Operational and financial risk management principles.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to conduct complex enterprise-wide risk assessments and develop practical mitigation strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, emerging risks, and systemic issues.
  • Experience preparing executive-level reports, dashboards, and presentations.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex risk concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to develop, interpret, and refine corporate policies and procedures.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to operate independently and effectively in a fully remote environment.

Technical Proficiency

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint).
  • Adobe Acrobat and/or Bluebeam.
  • Power BI or comparable business intelligence platforms.
  • Risk management, reporting, and data analytics systems.
  • AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies that enhance operational efficiency, analytics, and risk visibility.

Physical Requirements

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

  • Frequently remain in a stationary position while performing work.
  • Frequently move through office, client, and other business environments.
  • Occasionally move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

Travel Requirements

  • Travel may include client meetings, employee meetings, business development activities, conferences, training events, and other business-related functions.

Education and Experience

  • Admission to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Undergraduate degree in business, finance, accounting, economics, construction, engineering or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience in contract law, insurance law, risk management, or a closely related field at a law firm, in-house or with an insurance carrier.
  • Prior experience in construction, engineering or design industries.

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

jobs.excerpt: Sierra Space Careers:At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.
jobs.description:
Sierra Space Careers:

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role

Sierra Space is seeking a Sr Guidance, Navigation & Control Engineer to lead the design, development, and verification of advanced GNC systems for spacecraft applications. This senior-level role requires extensive experience in GNC algorithm design, sensor and actuator selection, and system-level integration. The selected candidate will be responsible for architecting integrated GNC designs, creating detailed plans for program execution, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to ensure performance across spacecraft subsystems. This role offers the opportunity to drive innovation and technical excellence in aerospace technology.

In this role, you will design and implement advanced guidance and control algorithms, including optimal control and autonomous navigation techniques using LIDAR, vision, GPS, and RGPS systems. You will lead the end-to-end design and development of GNC algorithms, architect integrated subsystem designs, and quantify performance impacts. Additionally, you will develop Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) tasking, long-term plans, and Gantt charts for program execution, supporting internal and external proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs). You will perform sensor and actuator selection and sizing based on program requirements, leveraging and developing relevant design tools. Furthermore, you will assist in Assembly, Integration, and Test (AI&T) by conducting HITL unit and integrated testing to verify GNC subsystem performance. You will set up integrated closed-loop dynamic models and GNC simulations, perform MIMO linearization, and analyze complex closed-loop data interactions. Moreover, you will decompose high-level requirements into low-level GNC subsystem requirements, translating them into sensor and actuator sizing and selection. Finally, you will interface sensors with onboard avionics by addressing physical compute limitations, defining interfaces, and developing target timing requirements.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer

Location: Remote – Mainland USA
Department: Product Design
Reports to: Director, Product Design

Visa Sponsorship: Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this position.

Why Join Omnicell?

At Omnicell, we’re transforming medication management by building a unified, cloud‑based platform that connects automated dispensing cabinets, mobile workflows, and AI‑powered intelligence into a single, cohesive ecosystem. Our work directly impacts clinicians, pharmacists, and patients—helping healthcare teams work safer, faster, and smarter every day.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll design beyond screens. You’ll shape end‑to‑end journeys across cloud, mobile, and device experiences, partner deeply with product and engineering, and use AI‑assisted tools to move from insight to working prototype faster than traditional design processes allow. If you’re excited to replace static specs with interactive, testable solutions—and bring consumer‑grade usability to healthcare—this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

Purpose: Own the full design arc—from discovery through validated, code‑backed prototypes—delivering outcomes that improve clinical workflows, product adoption, and business performance.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will:

Design, Drafting & Prototyping

  • Lead end‑to‑end journey design, accounting for system states, edge cases, error handling, and recovery paths—not just happy‑path screens.
  • Deliver interactive, high‑fidelity prototypes (using tools such as Figma Make, vibe‑coding environments, or equivalent) as the primary design artifact; static specifications are the exception.
  • Translate patterns and interactions from adjacent industries (fintech, retail, consumer tech) into healthcare‑appropriate solutions that meet regulatory and clinical constraints.
  • Contribute to and evolve Omnicell’s design system, including tokens, components, and usage guidelines across cloud, mobile, and device surfaces.

AI Integration & Innovation

  • Use AI daily as a design partner—for ideation, layout exploration, content generation, research synthesis, and code‑assisted prototyping.
  • Apply clear quality criteria to evaluate AI outputs, refining or rejecting suggestions based on user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Explore and prototype AI‑enabled experiences such as adaptive interfaces, intelligent workflows, and data‑driven recommendations.

Collaboration & Influence

  • Facilitate cross‑functional design sprints and workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and clinical subject‑matter experts.
  • Operate within durable product triads (Designer + PM + Engineering Lead), focused on shipping outcomes—not handoffs.
  • Influence decisions beyond your immediate team by clearly articulating trade‑offs, presenting rationale, and building alignment across stakeholders.

Customer Value & Discovery

  • Lead discovery and validation efforts through journey mapping, ethnographic research, and user interviews with pharmacists, clinicians, and operations teams.
  • Apply methods from service design, behavioral science, and operations research to deeply understand complex pharmacy and medication workflows.

Business Acumen

  • Tie design decisions to measurable outcomes such as adoption, task‑time reduction, NPS, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor competitive and market trends to inform differentiation and platform‑level design strategy.

Mentorship & Craft Evolution

  • Coach peers through regular feedback, documented best practices, and shared craft playbooks that scale team impact.
  • Challenge assumptions, lead retrospectives, and drive process improvements when evidence calls for change.

Who You Are

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product design experience delivering complex, multi‑workflow systems in healthcare, enterprise SaaS, or similarly regulated domains.
  • A portfolio that emphasizes interactive prototypes, demonstrating end‑to‑end journeys, systems thinking, and measurable user or business impact.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including AI‑assisted capabilities (e.g., Figma Make), with comfort using code‑backed prototyping or vibe‑coding tools.
  • Proven experience integrating AI into your design workflow beyond copywriting—partnering with AI for research synthesis, strategic exploration, and prototyping.
  • Strong facilitation and storytelling skills, with the ability to present to leadership and influence cross‑functional teams without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing across cloud, mobile, and hardware‑adjacent interfaces within a shared ecosystem.
  • Background in healthcare, clinical workflows, or regulated product environments.
  • Familiarity with service design or systems‑level design methodologies.
  • Education in design, HCI, psychology, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

How You’ll Elevate at Omnicell

At Omnicell, success is defined not only by what you deliver, but how you deliver it. As a Senior Product Designer, you will:

  • Collaborate: Build trusted partnerships with product, engineering, and clinical teams to solve complex problems together.
  • Inspire: Elevate the quality of design thinking across teams through strong rationale, clear storytelling, and bold exploration.
  • Develop: Continuously grow your craft while actively mentoring others and contributing to shared standards.
  • Execute: Take ownership of outcomes, prioritize effectively, and move ideas from insight to shippable solutions.
  • Impact: Drive meaningful improvements in healthcare experiences by challenging assumptions and designing for real‑world use.

jobs.description:
About Jade Biosciences

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. Jade’s lead candidate, JADE101, targets the cytokine APRIL, and is currently being evaluated in a Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of immunoglobulin A nephropathy. Jade’s pipeline also includes JADE201, an afucosylated anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody, as well as JADE301, an undisclosed antibody candidate, both currently in preclinical development. Jade was launched based on assets licensed from Paragon Therapeutics, an antibody discovery engine founded by Fairmount. For more information, visit  and follow the Company on LinkedIn.  

Role Overview

The Research and Translational Medicine group at Jade is looking to add a Principal Scientist, Translational Research, to our team. This role will provide scientific leadership across immunology-driven research activities that support Jade’s pipeline programs, including mechanism-of-action studies, disease biology assessment, indication evaluation, and translational strategy. The Principal Scientist will integrate literature, experimental data, and translational insights to strengthen program rationale, inform clinical development, and identify opportunities for pipeline expansion. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing, highly collaborative biotech team and contribute to the advancement of potentially best-in-class therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

This is a fully remote role, preferably based on the U.S. West Coast, with occasional domestic and international travel. The position reports to the Executive Director, Research and Translational Medicine.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead immunology-driven research strategy across pipeline programs to support scientific narrative and indication assessment, integrating literature, experimental data, and translational insights
  • Design and oversee mechanism-of-action studies to elucidate target biology, pathway modulation, and disease relevance across in vitro, ex vivo, and in vivo models, executed in partnership with CROs
  • Partner closely with Translational Medicine, Clinical Pharmacology, and Nonclinical teams to ensure alignment of preclinical findings with clinical strategy
  • Generate and interpret complex datasets (e.g., cellular immunology, cytokine profiling, pathway analysis), ensuring rigorous and hypothesis-driven conclusions
  • Identify and validate new targets and pathways for pipeline expansion, leveraging deep understanding of disease biology, emerging science, and internal platform capabilities
  • Evaluate and prioritize new indication opportunities, integrating mechanistic rationale, competitive landscape, and translational feasibility
  • Support external collaborations and CRO activities, providing scientific direction and technical oversight to ensure high-quality data generation

jobs.title: Revenue Enablement Manager
jobs.excerpt: Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean.
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Enablement to own and build our Go-To-Market enablement function. Reporting to the Head of Revenue, you will be the connective tissue between product knowledge, sales process, and rep performance — the person who makes sure our team has everything they need to close deals with confidence.

The defining characteristic of the right candidate is curiosity. This person must genuinely want to master our products, customers, and industry. They will develop deep fluency in AI by working closely with product and engineering, then translate that fluency into training, coaching, and programs that make reps measurably better.

This is a builder role. The successful hire will create core content, establish a rigorous certification program, and remain present on the floor — watching calls, coaching individual reps, running workshops, and holding themselves accountable to whether reps actually improve.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and continuously improve the AE onboarding program — a 4-week ramp covering AI/ML fundamentals, product, sales process, and pitch certification — ensuring new hires ramp quickly and reference it long after week four.
  • Build and maintain a pitch deck and talk track library across all major use cases — code completion, code fixing, conversational AI, search, voice, and agentic — keeping materials current as the product and competitive landscape evolve.
  • Design and run a quarterly pitch certification program with real stakes: a clear rubric, consistent scoring, structured feedback, and defined follow-through for reps who do not meet the standard.
  • Coach reps directly and consistently — joining live and recorded calls, running structured debriefs, and facilitating workshops — so that sellers see you as a go-to resource, not just a program manager.
  • Run the recurring enablement cadence: monthly newsletter, win wires, competitive seller briefs, and any sessions that keep the team sharp, informed, and connected to what is working.
  • Manage the content management system and Revenue Resources Confluence space, ensuring every asset is accurate, organized, and easy to find across the entire revenue team.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations, Product, PMM, Sales Leadership, and Marketing to ensure enablement is grounded in the latest GTM priorities, product developments, and competitive intelligence.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience in sales enablement or sales training at a technical B2B company
  • Demonstrated experience building an enablement program from scratch — not inheriting and maintaining an existing one
  • Direct, one-on-one coaching experience with Account Executives, not solely program or content design
  • Experience managing a portfolio of concurrent programs and projects with competing priorities
  • Proven ability to operate in fast-moving environments where the product roadmap and GTM strategy evolve regularly

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in AI/ML, infrastructure, developer tools, or a technical API-first company
  • Has designed and administered a formal sales certification program with defined evaluation criteria
  • Skilled at enabling AEs to engage credibly with technical buyers — including ML engineers and platform leads — without positioning them as pseudo-Solutions Engineers
  • Familiarity with enablement platforms and content management systems (e.g., Spekit, Highspot, Seismic)
  • Experience enabling both commercial and enterprise sales motions simultaneously
  • Background in or exposure to sales methodologies such as Command of the Message or MEDDPICC
  • Competitive compensation: Salary and bonuses tied to individual and company performance.
  • Equity: Grants upon hire and participation in our Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Formalized mentorship, conference reimbursement, and deep investment in your professional development.
  • Remote-first flexibility: We are a global organization that values your well-being and provides resources to support it.

Compensation Range:

  • $160,000 - $195,000

*This is a remote role

JR: 2026-8039

Why You’ll Like Working for DigitalOcean

  • We innovate with purpose. You’ll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.
  • We prioritize career development. At DO, you’ll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000+ courses to support their continued growth and development.
  • We care about your well-being. Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences.
  • We reward our employees. The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program.

The Learning Systems Analyst plays a key role in the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of Blackbaud’s learning technology ecosystem. This role is responsible for the operational health, consistency, and scalability of enterprise learning platforms, including DevelopU (Docebo) and other learning systems as the ecosystem evolves.

This is a systems and enablement role, not a centralized content production role. In addition to core platform administration, the Senior Learning Systems Analyst defines standards, structures, and guidance that help stakeholders use learning platforms effectively and consistently while maintaining clear ownership of their content and programs.

The Learning Systems Analyst partners closely with Learning & Development, HR, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure learning platforms are well governed, integrated where appropriate, and aligned with business needs. The role requires sound judgment, strong systems thinking, and comfort operating in a changing environment where tools, priorities, and processes continue to evolve.

Key Responsibilities

Learning Systems Administration & Governance

  • Administer, configure, and maintain enterprise learning platforms, including courses, learning plans, users, enrollments, roles, and permissions
  • Support one or more learning systems as part of a broader learning technology ecosystem, ensuring consistent governance and user experience across platforms
  • Maintain data integrity, audit readiness, and compliance through regular reviews, controls, and documentation

Stakeholder Enablement & Platform Guidance

jobs.title: Supervisor de Vendas (PI)
jobs.excerpt: O Supervisor de Vendas é responsável por coordenar e monitorar o desempenho comercial de uma ou mais linhas de produtos específicas da Anton Paar, garantindo o alcance das metas de vendas, a saúde do *pipeline*, o acompanhamento estratégico de oportunidades e o suporte direto à equipe de vendas.
jobs.description:
O Supervisor de Vendas é responsável por coordenar e monitorar o desempenho comercial de uma ou mais linhas de produtos específicas da Anton Paar, garantindo o alcance das metas de vendas, a saúde do *pipeline*, o acompanhamento estratégico de oportunidades e o suporte direto à equipe de vendas.

Atua como elo entre a equipe de vendas, clientes, áreas internas e a matriz, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas, negociações relevantes, monitoramento de KPIs, previsão de vendas e o desenvolvimento de ações necessárias para o crescimento sustentável da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atividades

Gestão da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade

  • Monitorar o desempenho comercial mensal da linha, acompanhando resultados de vendas, projeções de receita, oportunidades em aberto e o progresso em relação à meta anual.
  • Analisar a saúde do *pipeline* da linha sob sua responsabilidade, avaliando o volume de oportunidades, o estágio no funil de vendas, a probabilidade de sucesso, os prazos previstos de fechamento e os riscos relacionados ao alcance das metas.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos individuais mensais com os vendedores responsáveis ​​pelas oportunidades da linha, revisando KPIs, status de negociação, qualidade do funil, prioridades comerciais e próximos passos.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias comerciais para garantir o alcance das metas da linha, considerando o mercado, clientes estratégicos, carteira ativa, oportunidades em andamento e ações necessárias para o desenvolvimento de novos negócios.

Monitoramento de vendas, previsão (*forecast*) e KPIs

  • Monitorar os números mensais de vendas da linha, bem como a projeção de vendas até o final do ano, antecipando possíveis desvios e propondo ações corretivas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de vendas, como oportunidades em aberto, progresso no funil de vendas, probabilidade de fechamento, volume de propostas, descontos aplicados, previsão de vendas (*forecast*), conversão de oportunidades e aderência às metas.
  • Garantir que as informações relacionadas às oportunidades estejam atualizadas no CRM, permitindo análises confiáveis ​​do *pipeline*, da previsão de vendas e do desempenho da linha.
  • Avaliar oportunidades estratégicas com a equipe de vendas, apoiando a priorização de clientes, negociações e ações comerciais de maior impacto.

Suporte à equipe de vendas

  • Fornecer suporte direto à equipe de vendas em negociações relevantes, visitas estratégicas, definição da abordagem comercial e acompanhamento de oportunidades críticas.
  • Participar de visitas a clientes com os vendedores quando necessário, especialmente em oportunidades estratégicas, negociações complexas ou contas de maior relevância para a linha. Apoiar a equipe de vendas na análise e concessão de descontos, considerando a estratégia de vendas, a relevância da oportunidade, a competitividade, o relacionamento com o cliente e o impacto nos resultados da linha de produtos.
  • Orientar a equipe de vendas quanto às prioridades da linha, auxiliando na tomada de decisão sobre quais oportunidades devem receber maior foco e acompanhamento.
  • Dar suporte a processos comerciais específicos, incluindo licitações, solicitações de importação e alinhamentos técnicos e comerciais, sempre que relacionados às linhas de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.

Relacionamento com clientes, áreas internas e matriz

  • Manter bom relacionamento com clientes estratégicos, atuando como suporte à equipe de vendas em negociações, visitas e discussões comerciais ou técnicas, quando necessário.
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas envolvidas no processo comercial, como logística, importação, financeiro, serviços, aplicações, marketing e outras áreas de suporte.
  • Comunicar-se com a equipe da matriz quando necessário, incluindo solicitações de suporte técnico, alinhamento de estratégias globais, acompanhamento de importações, priorização de demandas ou apresentação dos resultados da linha de produtos no Brasil.
  • Compartilhar informações com a matriz sobre desempenho comercial, *pipeline*, previsões (*forecast*), desafios de mercado e estratégias aplicadas localmente.
  • Buscar compreender as estratégias globais para a linha de produtos e avaliar, juntamente com a equipe local, como aplicá-las ao mercado brasileiro.

Responsabilidades Estratégicas

  • Contribuir para a construção e execução da estratégia comercial da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Identificar riscos e oportunidades relacionados ao alcance das metas de vendas.
  • Apoiar a tomada de decisão da equipe de vendas com base em dados, indicadores, histórico de oportunidades e análise de mercado.
  • Atuar de forma proativa para identificar gargalos no *pipeline*, negociações travadas, oportunidades com baixa probabilidade de fechamento ou a necessidade de suporte adicional.
  • Promover o alinhamento constante entre vendedores, gerência de vendas e matriz em relação a prioridades, resultados e ações necessárias.

Qualificações

Habilidades Técnicas Necessárias

  • Conhecimento em gestão de vendas, *pipeline* de vendas, previsões (*forecast*) e análise de KPIs.
  • Experiência com vendas técnicas, consultivas ou de equipamentos/instrumentação.
  • Conhecimento em funil de vendas, gestão de oportunidades e acompanhamento de negociações complexas.
  • Capacidade de analisar dados comerciais e interpretar indicadores de desempenho.
  • Enviar feedback

Habilidades Técnicas Necessárias

  • Conhecimento em gestão de vendas, *pipeline* de vendas, previsão de vendas (*forecasting*) e análise de KPIs.
  • Experiência com vendas técnicas, consultivas ou de equipamentos/instrumentação.
  • Conhecimento de funil de vendas, gestão de oportunidades e acompanhamento de negociações complexas.
  • Capacidade de analisar dados comerciais e interpretar indicadores de desempenho.
  • Conhecimento de processos comerciais envolvendo propostas, descontos, licitações, importação e suporte técnico-comercial.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e no pacote Office, especialmente Excel e ferramentas de acompanhamento de indicadores.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, necessário para comunicação com a matriz, participação em alinhamentos globais, apresentação de resultados, solicitação de suporte técnico e acompanhamento de estratégias internacionais.

Habilidades Interpessoais / Competências Comportamentais

  • Perfil de liderança, com capacidade de orientar, influenciar e apoiar a equipe de vendas.
  • Boas habilidades interpessoais, tanto com a equipe interna quanto com clientes e a matriz.
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e colaborativa.
  • Empatia para compreender as necessidades da equipe, dos clientes e das áreas envolvidas.
  • Organização para acompanhar múltiplas oportunidades, indicadores, demandas e prioridades simultaneamente.
  • Resiliência para lidar com problemas, pressão por resultados, cenários em mudança e desafios comerciais.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões estratégicas, considerando dados, prioridades, riscos e o impacto nos resultados da linha de produtos.
  • Senso de prioridade para direcionar esforços a oportunidades e ações de maior relevância para o alcance das metas.
  • Visão analítica e estratégica para avaliar o *pipeline*, a previsão de vendas, o desempenho da linha e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Proatividade para antecipar problemas, propor soluções e buscar apoio interno ou da matriz quando necessário.
  • Atitude colaborativa, atuando como elo entre vendedores, clientes, áreas internas e a matriz.
  • O Supervisor de Vendas prioriza oportunidades de negócio, orienta a equipe de vendas e recomenda estratégias para atingir as metas da linha de produtos.
  • Também participa da análise de descontos, negociações estratégicas, avaliação da necessidade de suporte da matriz, definição de ações comerciais e acompanhamento de oportunidades críticas, sempre em alinhamento com as diretrizes da empresa e a gestão de vendas.

A Anton Paar Brasil é uma subsidiária do grupo Anton Paar, reconhecido mundialmente por sua excelência no desenvolvimento de instrumentos de alta precisão para medição e análise. Atuando em diversos setores, como o farmacêutico, de alimentos, químico e de petróleo, a empresa destaca-se pela inovação tecnológica, pela qualidade e pelo forte compromisso com a ciência. No Brasil, oferece suporte técnico especializado e soluções avançadas, contribuindo para o crescimento e a confiabilidade dos processos de seus clientes.

jobs.excerpt: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for:

As the Director, Arc - Capital Markets Strategy & GTM, you will define and execute Arc's capital markets ecosystem strategy, helping establish Arc as the leading blockchain network for institutional financial activity. Working across Ecosystem Partnerships, Product, and Commercial leadership, you will identify high-value market opportunities, develop the strategic roadmap for the capital markets ecosystem, architect complex partnership and commercial structures, and influence product investments required to unlock adoption.

This is not a traditional business development role. Success in this position comes from defining ecosystem strategy, influencing product direction, architecting partnerships, and creating market adoption across the capital markets value chain. While you will work closely with relationship owners and commercial teams, your focus is on building the capital markets ecosystem, not simply closing individual deals.

You will build and scale the capital markets ecosystem on Arc, creating a network of partners, use cases, and market participants that drive compounding on-chain activity and establish a durable competitive advantage in institutional finance. This is a highly strategic, zero-to-one role focused on ecosystem creation, market development, and product influence rather than traditional business development execution.

What success looks like:

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Develop and socialize a capital markets ecosystem strategy that aligns leadership, product, and commercial stakeholders around priority opportunities.

  • Establish strong working relationships across Product, Ecosystem Partnerships, Business Development, and executive leadership teams.

  • Identify key ecosystem dependencies, market gaps, and strategic partnership opportunities required to accelerate institutional adoption.

  • Build alignment around priority use cases, partnership opportunities, and product requirements needed to support ecosystem growth.

  • Establish an operating cadence with cross-functional stakeholders and define clear ownership across active initiatives.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will:

  • Help bring multiple strategic ecosystem partnerships from concept to execution, creating measurable momentum for Arc within capital markets.

  • Drive new on-chain activity through the successful launch of ecosystem participants, market infrastructure integrations, or institutional use cases.

  • Influence product roadmap priorities that unlock meaningful ecosystem growth and improve the competitiveness of Arc's capital markets offering.

  • Establish repeatable frameworks, partnership structures, and ecosystem development playbooks that enable long-term scale.

  • Build a visible pipeline of future ecosystem opportunities that demonstrate a clear path toward compounding network effects and sustained adoption.

What you'll work on:

  • Define and own the strategic roadmap for Arc's capital markets ecosystem, including market prioritization, ecosystem design, use-case sequencing, and long-term growth strategy.

  • Map and develop end-to-end capital markets value chains, identifying key participants, ecosystem dependencies, market gaps, and opportunities to accelerate institutional adoption.

  • Design and structure innovative commercial partnerships, business models, and economic frameworks that unlock new on-chain capital markets activity.

  • Partner closely with Business Development teams to evaluate, prioritize, and execute strategic partnerships that drive measurable ecosystem growth and network effects.

  • Influence product roadmaps by translating market needs, customer workflows, and ecosystem requirements into actionable product priorities across multiple product organizations.

  • Establish repeatable frameworks, operating models, and partnership playbooks that enable scalable ecosystem expansion and long-term growth.

  • Monitor ecosystem performance, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and market trends to continuously strengthen Arc's position within institutional capital markets.

What you'll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience spanning management consulting, corporate strategy, product management, enterprise partnerships, business development, or related strategic functions.

  • Demonstrated success defining and executing strategy in highly ambiguous, zero-to-one, or emerging-market environments.

  • Proven ability to influence executive leaders and drive alignment across multiple organizations without direct authority.

  • Experience building new business lines, ecosystem strategies, marketplace models, platform businesses, or network-driven growth initiatives.

  • Deep experience structuring complex enterprise partnerships, commercial agreements, and strategic alliances involving significant value exchange.

  • Strong systems-thinking capabilities with the ability to map value chains, identify leverage points, and create scalable growth strategies.

  • Exceptional communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills with experience engaging senior leaders both internally and externally.

Preferred Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of capital markets infrastructure, including securities issuance, trading, settlement, custody, market structure, or institutional investing.

  • Experience with tokenization, digital assets, blockchain infrastructure, real-world assets, or emerging financial technologies.

We are currently hiring a  Senior Delivery Manager  to help grow our company and ensure our mission is achieved!  

This role is work from home position and can be performed remotely anywhere in the continental US or in one of our corporate locations in Utah, Arizona or Colorado

Employee Value Proposition (EVP): PROG is dedicated to providing people with opportunity; opportunity for inclusive collaboration, opportunity for innovation, and opportunity for development.

WE ARE: Prog Tech is the driving force behind our company’s technological evolution. We are passionate problem solvers and technical experts, working together to deliver impactful solutions. We pride ourselves on craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and collaboration. Our culture encourages experimentation, learning from failures, and delivering meaningful outcomes.

YOU ARE: A technically fluent delivery manager who operates at the team level — close to the work, the risk, and the engineers doing both. You understand the full software development lifecycle, from planning through delivery. You build systems that create predictability, surface risk early, and protect delivery integrity. You influence engineers, product managers, and stakeholders through structure, data, and clear framing.

You are comfortable operating in ambiguity. When dependencies slip, scope pressure mounts, or execution variability surfaces, your instinct is to model the impact, structure the options, and reset expectations with clarity.

You are equally at home in flow-based, service-oriented environments where work is continuous and interrupt-driven as you are in iteration-based teams. You understand that delivery discipline looks different depending on the team operating model, and you adapt your approach accordingly without losing rigor.

You treat AI tools as force multipliers for delivery work by using them to draft communications, model trade-offs, accelerate backlog synthesis, and generate operational artifacts faster than manual methods allow. You have a point of view on where AI augments delivery rigor versus where it creates false confidence, and you apply that judgment deliberately.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:

Delivery System Operations

  • Maintain and improve delivery visibility across complex, dependency-heavy work by tracking cross-team blockers, integration risks, and upstream/downstream exposure

  • Model the impact of scope changes, timeline shifts, and capacity constraints by presenting structured options with clear trade-offs to decision-makers

  • Drive backlog readiness discipline, ensuring work entering execution is well-defined and dependency-mapped before it starts

  • Identify and actively manage delivery risk through surfacing issues proactively, quantifying impact, and framing resolution paths for engineering and product leadership

  • Maintain and improve delivery operating norms that reduce rework, carryover, and execution variability over time

  • Leverage AI tooling to accelerate operational work, including status synthesis, risk narrative generation, and backlog readiness summarization, while maintaining human judgment on prioritization and stakeholder framing decisions.

Influence and Stakeholder Management

  • Influence engineer and product manager behavior through structure and data by driving accountability and shared clarity on delivery commitments

  • Frame delivery trade-offs clearly by presenting structured options with explicit implications on timeline, quality, and capacity

  • Partner with Product Managers to enforce readiness standards and protect delivery integrity when scope pressure mounts

  • Communicate delivery feasibility and confidence clearly to the engineering team and partnering Project Managers by providing early warning when assumptions change and surfacing recovery options when they do

  • Socialize production release schedules in advance with the development team, Product Manager, and relevant change advisory processes ensuring the team is prepared for releases

Technical Fluency

  • Maintain working fluency in the technical systems your team supports through a solid understanding of integration surfaces, API dependencies, and release risk in context

  • Coordinate across engineering, QE, architecture, and platform teams to manage cross-functional dependencies and resolve blockers at the right level

  • Apply delivery metrics (i.e. cycle time, throughput, carryover, predictability) as operational signals that drive structural change in how the team works

Service-Oriented Team Operations

  • Manage a Kanban-based delivery system for a team handling a mix of planned work and high-priority operational demand

  • Balance intake discipline with responsiveness by maintaining flow efficiency while protecting planned delivery commitments from reactive work pressure

  • Model WIP impact and context-switching costs to protect team throughput and focus

  • Maintain and improve intake and triage processes that bring structure to interrupt-driven work without creating bureaucratic overhead

  • Monitor Kanban flow metrics (i.e. lead time, cycle time, and queue depth) to identify bottlenecks and maintain healthy throughput

  • Coordinate with dependent teams and platform consumers to maintain demand visibility and set clear expectations proactively

Iteration-Based Team Operations

  • Manage sprint cadence and iteration health across one or more engineering teams with a focus on commitment reliability and sprint goal integrity

  • Enforce sprint entry discipline by ensuring stories meet sizing and readiness standards before planning begins, and holding the line when they don’t

  • Track and improve sprint predictability using carryover, velocity trends, and planning accuracy as signals to adjust how the team operates

  • Manage scope pressure during active sprints through modeling the impact of additions or changes and presenting clear trade-off options to the Product Manager before commitments shift

  • Maintain cross-sprint dependency visibility across teams or workstreams, identifying what is at risk and when

  • Run retrospectives as structured operational reviews by identifying systemic delivery friction and driving follow-through on changes

YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5 to 7 years of delivery management experience embedded within software engineering teams in a fintech or similarly regulated, technically complex environment

  • Demonstrated ability to influence engineer and product manager behavior through structure, data, and clear framing

  • Proven experience building or materially improving delivery systems: reducing carryover, improving commitment reliability, or increasing planning quality through structural changes

  • Experience modeling delivery trade-offs and presenting structured options to leadership

  • Deep SDLC fluency, including integration complexity, release management, dependency modeling, and cross-team coordination

  • Strong working knowledge of Jira for dependency tracking, delivery modeling, and operational insight

  • Comfort operating in API-heavy, integration-dependent backend environments where delivery risk lives in the connections between systems

  • Prior experience managing Kanban-based teams in service-oriented or platform engineering environments

  • Demonstrated use of flow metrics (i.e. lead time, cycle time, WIP) as day-to-day operational tools for managing team health and throughput

  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tooling (LLMs, AI-augmented Jira workflows, or similar) to improve delivery throughput, reduce coordination overhead, or accelerate artifact generation with the discernment to know when AI output requires human review before it reaches stakeholders.

  • Calm, structured approach to ambiguity and able to reset expectations and protect delivery integrity when plans change

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to frame engineering consequences clearly for non-technical stakeholders

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

YOU MIGHT ALSO HAVE:

  • Prior experience managing sprint-based teams, including planning discipline, Definition of Ready enforcement, and iteration health management

  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, deployment infrastructure, or cloud services sufficiently enough to understand release risk and coordinate across platform teams

  • Experience coordinating across both iterative (sprint-based) and continuous-flow (Kanban) teams within the same organization

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar change management tooling in a governed release environment

  • Experience supporting offshore or distributed engineering teams with uneven execution maturity

  • Agile, Scrum, or Kanban certification (CSM, PSM, KMP, or equivalent)

WE OFFER:

  • Competitive Compensation

  • Full Health Benefits; Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance + Paid Parental Leave

  • Company Matched 401k

  • Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays + Paid Volunteer Hours

  • Employee Resource Groups (Black Inclusion Group, Women in Leadership, PRIDE, Adelante)

  • Job required equipment and services

Financial Modeling & Strategic Analysis

  • Strong analytical thinker capable of turning complex data into simple, actionable insights

Preferred Experience & Skills
