jobs.description:
About Vesta

Vesta helps wireless providers make more money byimprovinga part of theirbusinessmostdon’tthink about — payments. Vesta works with major names like AT&T, Rogers, Telcel, and Vodafone, helping them stop fraud, reduce failed transactions, and make sure moretransactions are successful. ForMNOs,MVNOs and prepaid carriers, this can mean fewer lost customers and more revenue — all without adding friction to the checkout experience. With over 100 million transactions processed every year in 40+ countries, Vestahelpswireless providers turn their payment systems into a competitive advantage.

Position Summary

Vesta Corporation is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and ongoing operations of our global enterprise network. This is a senior individual-contributor role operating at the intersection of complex multi-site networking, hybrid cloud infrastructure, and PCI compliance. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience, deep fluency with AWS network architecture and security services, strong familiarity with both commercial and open-source tooling, and the ability to drive infrastructure modernization initiatives with limited oversight.

Key Responsibilities

On-Premises & Hybrid Network Infrastructure

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure network infrastructure across data centers, remote sites, and AWS/Azure cloud environments.
  • Architect and operate routing and switching infrastructure including BGP, NAT, VLANs, Spanning Tree, IPsec VPNs and HSRP.
  • Manage and tune enterprise firewall platforms (Cisco, pfSense, Check Point) in alignment with PCI DSS segmentation and access control requirements.
  • Administer and optimize F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM for application delivery, load balancing, and traffic steering across production environments.
  • Manage Cloudflare DNS, WAF, and network security policies for internet-facing properties.
  • Maintain network security policy management via FireMon; contribute to access path analysis and rule lifecycle management.
  • Manage Proxmox-based virtualization as it relates to network-adjacent workloads and VM/LXC networking.
  • Coordinate with vendors and carriers to manage WAN circuits, resolve outages, and drive cost optimization.

AWS Network Design & Operations

  • Design, deploy, and maintain AWS Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) including subnet design, CIDR allocation, route tables, internet gateways, and NAT gateways across multi-account and multi-region environments.
  • Architect and manage VPC-to-VPC connectivity via VPC Peering, AWS Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink to support secure, scalable inter-service communication.
  • Configure and maintain AWS Site-to-Site VPN and Direct Connect circuits for hybrid connectivity between on-premises data centers and AWS environments.
  • Design and enforce AWS Security Group and Network ACL policies as network-layer access controls, aligned with PCI DSS segmentation requirements.
  • Manage DNS architecture within AWS using Route 53 for private hosted zones, resolver endpoints, conditional forwarding, and DNS failover across hybrid environments.
  • Configure and manage AWS NAT Gateways, Elastic IPs, and Elastic Load Balancers (ALB/NLB) for workload exposure and traffic routing.
  • Maintain AWS network connectivity for partner data and compute workloads migrated into cloud environments, including GDPR and data sovereignty considerations.

AWS Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain AWS security controls at the network layer including Security Groups, NACLs, VPC Flow Logs, and WAF rulesets on CloudFront and ALB.
  • Enable and manage AWS CloudTrail across accounts to ensure comprehensive API activity logging; integrate with centralized SIEM for alerting and audit evidence.
  • Configure and maintain AWS GuardDuty for threat detection; triage findings and drive remediation in coordination with the security team.
  • Manage AWS Security Hub to aggregate and prioritize findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, and third-party integrations; produce compliance posture reports for PCI DSS and SOC 1 Type 2 audits.
  • Administer AWS IAM policies, roles, and permission boundaries as they relate to network resource access; enforce least-privilege principles across VPC, Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway configurations.
  • Use AWS Config rules and AWS Organizations SCPs to enforce network security standards and detect drift across multi-account environments.

Monitoring, Observability & Automation

  • Monitor AWS network health using VPC Flow Logs, CloudWatch metrics and alarms, Transit Gateway Network Manager, and Reachability Analyzer.
  • Build and maintain CloudWatch dashboards and alarms for network throughput, latency, NAT gateway utilization, VPN tunnel status, and Direct Connect metrics.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and operationalize FOSS tools as replacements for commercial products where appropriate (e.g., Oxidized, NetBox)
  • Contribute to Infrastructure as Code for network resources using automation; enforce configuration consistency across environments.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for network topology, configurations, and operational runbooks; support PCI DSS and SOC 1 Type 2 audit evidence collection.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and be available for after-hours work including unscheduled incidents.
  • Travel to domestic data center and office locations as needed to support deployments or incidents.

Technical Expertise & Core Competencies

Required On-Premises

  • 10+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience in large-scale, multi-site environments.
  • Expert-level Cisco routing and switching: IOS/NX-OS, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP, QoS.
  • Enterprise firewall administration: Cisco ASA/FTD, pfSense, and Check Point. Rule management, segmentation strategy, and change control.
  • F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM: virtual servers, pools, iRules, traffic policies, and GTM topology records.
  • Cloudflare: DNS management, WAF rulesets, and security policy administration.
  • FireMon: policy analysis, rule review workflows, and access path validation.
  • Deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing/switching protocols, and secure remote access.
  • Experience operating in PCI DSS compliant environments including control implementation and audit evidence collection.

Required AWS Networking & Security:

  • VPC architecture: subnet design and CIDR planning, route tables, internet gateways, NAT gateways, and VPC endpoints.
  • VPC connectivity: VPC Peering, Transit Gateway, and AWS PrivateLink for inter-VPC and cross-account routing.
  • Hybrid connectivity: Site-to-Site VPN and Direct Connect configuration, BGP peering, and failover design.
  • Security controls: Security Groups, Network ACLs, and VPC Flow Logs for traffic visibility and PCI segmentation enforcement.
  • DNS: Route 53 private hosted zones, resolver endpoints, conditional forwarding rules, and health-check-based failover.
  • Load balancing and exposure: Application Load Balancer (ALB), Network Load Balancer (NLB), and Elastic IP management.
  • Monitoring and observability: CloudWatch metrics, alarms, dashboards; VPC Flow Logs analysis; Transit Gateway Network Manager.
  • Security and compliance services: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, IAM policy review, and ACM.
  • Multi-account governance: AWS Organizations, SCPs, and Control Tower network guardrails.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Proxmox VE: VM/LXC provisioning, cluster management, and software-defined networking.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or CloudFormation for network resource provisioning and drift detection.
  • Experience deploying FOSS tools to replace commercial networking or monitoring products (e.g., Oxidized, NetBox).
  • Azure networking: Azure Firewall, NSGs, and Azure DNS private zones.
  • Zero-trust / overlay VPN concepts and implementation (e.g., Tailscale or Wireguard).
  • AWS advanced networking: CloudFront distributions, WAF on ALB/CloudFront, PrivateLink endpoint services, Network Firewall.
  • Scripting or automation: Python, Bash, or Ansible for network task automation.
  • Vendor management: circuit provisioning, carrier escalations, and hardware lifecycle coordination.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise networking experience in complex, multi-site or global environments.
  • Demonstrated hands-on proficiency with AWS networking and security services in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and drive projects to completion without heavy oversight.
  • Strong vendor management skills, able to coordinate service delivery and incident resolution with carriers, ISPs, and hardware vendors.
  • Proven ability to document infrastructure for audits, incident response, and operational continuity.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically as needed (valid driver’s license required).
  • Available for on-call rotation and after-hours support windows.

Education & Certifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Required Certifications

  • Cisco CCNP (or higher) Enterprise, Data Center, or Security track.

Preferred Certifications

  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking, Specialty (ANS-C01) or AWS Solutions Architect | Professional.
  • AWS Certified Security, Specialty (SCS) is a strong differentiator given the compliance posture of this role.
  • Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate or equivalent Azure networking certification.
  • Check Point CCSE or equivalent firewall platform certification.
  • CCIE (any track), F5 Certified BIG-IP Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or other advanced certifications.

A. Execution, Delivery & Portfolio Accountability

As an employee-owner, you embrace accountability, working safely, and collaboration while thinking resourcefully and independently.

Like all Dudekians, you are curious and solution-oriented, with the ability to adapt quickly to changes and approach challenges with a spirit of innovation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

We’re looking for an experienced Archaeologist to serve as a technical leader on complex cultural resource management (CRM) projects to join our Florida based team. Direct experience working in Florida (particularly South Florida) is strongly desired, as is the ability to travel and work outside of this region. Archaeological experience in additional states along the Eastern Seaboard is a plus. In this role, you’ll coordinate with clients, lead field investigations, shape research strategies, and apply advanced methods to real-world archaeological challenges.

You’ll oversee key technical work — from developing field methodologies and analyzing data to ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations. As a subject matter expert, you’ll provide guidance to clients and project teams, mentor junior staff, and help drive high-quality, defensible results.

This role requires deep expertise in archaeological field methods, artifact analysis, and geospatial tools, along with a strong understanding of industry standards and regulatory requirements. You’ll also collaborate across teams to keep work aligned with project goals and timelines.

Dudek has a strong, invested, and collaborative cultural resources team with members located in surrounding regions. A successful applicant will be proactive, team-oriented, and eager to collaborate with both the cultural resources group and the broader Dudek regional environmental team. You will work closely with, and be supervised by, Dudek’s senior archaeologist on the Florida based team.

To thrive at Dudek, you should be comfortable with freedom and accountability. We value collaborative, resourceful, and independent thinkers. We look for curious, solution-focused people who are able to adapt quickly to an ever-changing industry. There is no single way to solve a problem, so we support your creative approaches to solve problems.

Technical Leadership and Field Methodologies

  • Designs and implements advanced archaeological field survey, excavation, and site assessment methodologies.
  • Possesses ability to use key technologies, such as ground penetrating radar, GIS, LiDAR, laser scanning, and remote sensing to enhance site analysis and predictive modeling.
  • Develops and refines artifact recovery, documentation, and conservation techniques.
  • Ensures consistency and accuracy in field data collection through quality control measures.

Data Analysis and Research

  • Conducts high-level statistical and geospatial analysis to interpret archaeological findings.
  • Develops predictive modeling techniques for identifying and assessing archaeological sensitivity areas.
  • Integrates environmental, geological, and hydrological data into cultural resource analyses.
  • Performs detailed artifact analysis, including material composition studies and use-wear analysis.

Technical Reporting and Documentation

  • Prepares and peer reviews comprehensive technical reports, ensuring accuracy in methodologies, findings, and regulatory compliance.
  • Develops and refines standardized reporting procedures and documentation protocols.

Mentorship and Technical Training

  • Provides technical training and mentors junior archaeologists in advanced field methods, data analysis, and reporting standards.
  • Develops internal best practices for field documentation, artifact processing, and regulatory compliance.
  • Conducts workshops and training sessions on emerging archaeological technologies and methodologies.
  • Mentorship and Technical Training

Business Development

  • Leverages technical expertise to help sell focused services, including writing proposals, developing budgets, and coordinating with the team to market to potential clients and client sectors.
  • Partners with Project Managers/Proposal Champions on complex project pursuits.
  • Actively monitors and responds effectively to technology, research, and industry trends.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: 12+ years’ experience in archaeological fieldwork, technical research, and CRM, including a minimum of 5 years’ experience designing and leading fieldwork and ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Education: Advanced degree (Masters or Doctorate) in Archaeology, Anthropology, or a related field.
  • Meets the Secretary of the Interior's Professional Qualifications Standards for Archaeology.
  • Demonstrated technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Ability to mentor and train junior staff in technical and methodological aspects of archaeological fieldwork and lab processing.
  • Experience working with indigenous communities and facilitating tribal consultation processes.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret cultural findings and focus on data-driven reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong background in statistical and spatial analysis for archaeological data interpretation.
  • Willingness to travel for fieldwork, often in remote locations and under challenging conditions.
  • Registered Professional Archaeologist (RPA)
  • Maintains good professional relationships (is in “good standing”) with regional federal and state agency reviewers and Tribal contacts.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain positive working relationships with coworkers, clients, agency staff, landowners, and field crews
  • Ability to give clear direction to field crews and receive constructive feedback on deliverables
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate field challenges, resolve conflicts, and communicate effectively across project teams

Compensation: $75,000-$95,000 annually*

*Final agreed-upon compensation will be based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s related experience, education, certifications, skills, and work location. Successful candidates must pass a pre-employment drug test and background check prior to beginning employment.

Working Conditions

  • This job operates in a remote or office-based environment and this role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, etc.
  • This job requires occasional project site visits, based outdoors which can include excessive noise, uneven walking surfaces, extreme weather, and moving vehicles and equipment.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. This job requires the following:

  • Working on a computer, sitting, or standing for long periods of time in an office or remote office setting.
  • Employees must be capable of bending, squatting, climbing ladders, and lifting up to 35 lbs. unassisted; 50lbs in a team lift (two or more employees).
  • This job requires attending meetings, both in person and virtually as well as speaking on the phone with government agency representatives, members of the public, and others. Speaking, hearing and listening are required.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Outdoor activity may involve walking/trekking in uneven terrain over long distances in extreme weather conditions for extended periods of time.

Description:

The SFDC & GTM Applications Technical Lead serves as the company’s subject matter expert for designing, building, integrating, and continuously improving scalable solutions across GTM and revenue systems. This role focuses on complex Salesforce work, system integrations, automation, data flows, and technical troubleshooting. While the role will act as the company’s CPQ subject matter expert and single process owner for the remainder of the CPQ lifecycle, it also requires strong technical judgment across current and future systems.

The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of systems thinking, GTM platform expertise, and business judgment. Rather than building before fully understanding the problem, they evaluate requests through both business and technical lenses, assess downstream impacts, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and deliver practical solutions that improve scalability, data integrity, user experience, and operational efficiency.

This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, owns complex cross-functional initiatives, and helps shape the long-term direction of Salesforce and GTM systems while partnering closely with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and technical stakeholders.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

GTM Systems Strategy and Salesforce CPQ

  • Own the Salesforce CPQ domain end to end, including product setup, bundles, pricing rules, discounting logic, quote templates, approval workflows, renewals, amendments, and quote-to-cash issue resolution.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert and decision-maker for CPQ process design, platform standards, and future-state roadmap.

· Apply strong technical judgment across Salesforce and connected GTM systems to determine when to use Apex, Flow, managed package capabilities, APIs, middleware, or custom development to solve business problems.

  • Identify process friction, technical debt, and operational risk across the revenue lifecycle and drive improvements that increase efficiency and reduce manual work.

Solution Design and Platform Administration

· Design scalable business system solutions using the right mix of declarative configuration, platform automation, integrations, and custom development.

  • Lead or support complex Salesforce configuration and enhancements, including custom objects, fields, flows, validation rules, approvals, record types, permissions, page layouts, and user experience improvements.
  • Evaluate when to use low-code versus coded solutions, considering reliability, supportability, performance, security, and ease of administration.

· Translate business needs into sustainable system solutions, bridging technical and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and practical for end users.

  • Integrations, Data, and Quote-to-Cash Operations
  • Support integrations and data flows between Salesforce and all relevant GTM and operational application systems.
  • Understand and troubleshoot how data moves across systems, including mapping logic, source-of-truth decisions, sync behavior, and downstream impacts.
  • Partner with technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve integration issues, improve data reliability, and reduce failure points across connected systems.
  • Delivery, Release, and Operational Excellence
  • Lead system-related initiatives from intake through discovery, design, build, testing, documentation, deployment, and post-launch support.
  • Support testing strategy, sandbox validation, release readiness, production monitoring, and issue resolution for system changes.
  • Support or coordinate technical work involving Flow, Apex, SOQL, Lightning components, APIs, middleware, and third-party tools where needed.
  • Establish and maintain documentation for system design, configuration standards, process flows, test plans, release notes, and support procedures.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner closely with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, and leadership to gather requirements and align solutions to business outcomes.
  • Lead through influence across teams, clarifying requirements, challenging assumptions, surfacing tradeoffs, and driving sound decision-making.
  • Communicate clearly on priorities, risks, solution options, and implementation impacts with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders on GTM system capabilities, limitations, governance, and best practices.
  • Support change management, training, and adoption efforts to ensure teams understand new processes and use the platform effectively.

Continuous Improvement and Governance

  • Stay current on Salesforce platform capabilities, GTM system trends, automation patterns, integration approaches, AI-enabled tools and functionality, and relevant best practices.

· Use technical expertise and business context to evaluate new tools, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities that simplify GTM processes, reduce manual work, improve decision-making, strengthen system sustainability, and support GTM efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Contribute to broader Salesforce and business systems strategy by identifying opportunities to simplify the stack, improve supportability, and strengthen business continuity.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in Salesforce administration, business systems, revenue operations, or Salesforce solution delivery roles.
  • 3+ years of direct experience owning or administering revenue systems, including Salesforce CPQ, in a complex B2B SaaS or similarly complex commercial environment.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce CPQ concepts, including product and pricing logic, pricing workflows, approval structures, and renewals/amendments operations.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives that require coordination across technical and business teams.
  • Proven ability to independently assess ambiguous business or system problems, recommend practical solutions, and execute with limited oversight.

Required Technical and Functional Skills

  • Deep expertise in revenue systems administration and configuration, including product setup, pricing rules, quote templates, approvals, guided selling, renewals, and amendments.
  • Strong Salesforce platform knowledge, including security models, data model design, automation architecture, integration patterns, and scalable configuration practices.

· Technical fluency across no-code, low-code, managed package, integration, and custom solution options, with the ability to recommend the best approach after reviewing options and trade-offs.

· Strong understanding of how GTM systems, data, and controls support the full revenue lifecycle, including quoting, contracting, renewals, billing handoffs, and related processes.

  • Experience partnering with vendors and business stakeholders to define requirements, evaluate solution options, and deliver and support scalable business systems.
  • Ability to make practical technical decisions that balance business urgency, system scalability, data quality, and integration impacts with long-term maintainability, supportability, and governance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification or deep hands-on Salesforce CPQ experience
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder, Advanced Administrator, or Developer 1 certification.

  • Experience in SaaS, subscription revenue, or high-growth operating environments.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled workflow design, process automation, or business systems optimization initiatives.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About the Company
Partnerships drive 30–50% of revenue for modern companies, yet many partner teams still rely on spreadsheets, email, Slack, and outdated CRMs that were never designed for partnership management. This creates inefficiencies, slows growth, and impacts revenue opportunities.
The company is building an AI-native PRM platform designed for modern partnership teams, helping eliminate manual work, improve partner collaboration, and transform partner activity into scalable and measurable revenue growth. The mission is to make partner revenue predictable and scalable.
The organization experienced 600% year-over-year growth in 2025 and currently works with industry-leading companies such as Anthropic, Starlink, Gong, and BambooHR. The team operates in a fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation, execution, and solving large-scale problems in the partner technology space.
About the Role

As our first Director of Sales, you will own the revenue engine. This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. It's for someone who owns the number, gets involved in key deals when it matters, and builds the playbook and team around what works. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the founding team.

You will inherit a team of four Account Executives selling across enterprise and mid-market segments, with a strong track record against established competitors. We have a solid pipeline, a proven sales motion, and customers who buy. Your job is to drive the team's revenue goals, help AEs close larger deals, and build the systems and processes needed to scale from our current stage to $10M, $20M, and $30M+ ARR.

This is a rare opportunity to shape a high-growth sales organization with strong foundations already in place and a product that is winning in the market.

Main Responsibilities
  • Own overall sales targets and be personally accountable for team ARR growth.
  • Coach,enable, and actively support AEs to close more and bigger deals, including jumping into live deals when needed.
  • Lead, develop, and grow a GTM team of Account Executives and SDRs across enterprise and mid-market segments.
  • Build and refine a scalable, repeatable sales playbook from prospecting through close.
  • Define sales processes, qualification frameworks, and pipeline management standards.
  • Partner with the CEO on go-to-market strategy, pricing, and expansion initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting in HubSpot.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement and bring forward thoughtful, actionable solutions.
  • Hire and onboard future sales talent as the team scales.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in B2B SaaS sales leadership, ideally having helped take a company from around $5M ARR to $10M, $20M, $30M or beyond.
  • A track record of owning a team number and coaching AEs to consistently exceed quota.
  • Hands-on leadership style. Comfortable jumping into a deal to unstick it, without needing to own a personal quota to stay sharp.
  • Experience building or refining sales processes in an early-stage or high-growth environment.
  • Strong command of both enterprise and mid-market sales motions: cold outreach, discovery, demos, negotiation, and complex deal cycles.
  • Consultative mindset, comfortable asking thoughtful questions, uncovering areas of improvement, and proposing solutions.
  • Highly autonomous. You don't need to be told what to do, you figure out what needs to happen and go do it.
  • Proficiency in HubSpot or equivalent CRM.
  • Self-starter, highly organized, and results-driven.
  • Experience selling PRM, CRM, or partnership software.
  • Familiarity with partner-led or channel sales models.
Why Join Us
  • Build and lead sales organization at a company already proving it can win against the biggest names in the category.
  • Report directly to the CEO with full visibility into company strategy.
  • Be part of a profitable, fast-growing startup with real traction, real logos, and real momentum.
  • No ego, full ownership, entrepreneurial culture.

Benefits

  • Salary: $5800 - $8300 + OTE
  • 100% Remote from LATAM

About Young Americans For Liberty

Founded after the 2008 Ron Paul Presidential Campaign, Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) is the nation’s largest pro-liberty youth movement, building a powerful network of activists to transform states into beacons of freedom.

We drive real change in America by working through our "Build - Elect - Pass" model:

  1. Build: We are building the largest nationwide movement of committed youth activists on American college campuses, with pro-liberty students fighting on hundreds of campuses across the country.
  2. Elect: We mobilize our base of committed youth activists to be the grassroots muscle on campaigns of principled liberty legislators through Operation Win at the Door. Since 2018, we've built a coalition of 400 active legislators in our National Liberty Legislator Coalition, and thousands of YAL-recruited students have knocked on over 6 million doors to turn out the vote.
  3. Pass: Use this coalition of principled liberty legislators to pass transformative policy at the state level. This coalition has already passed over 1,000 pro-liberty bills spanning from Universal School Choice, to Constitutional Carry, to major tax cuts and so much more. You can view the full list of bills passed at.

Mission & Vision

Our mission is to identify, educate, train, and mobilize youth activists committed to the ideals of liberty and the Constitution. Our vision is to create Liberty Lighthouse States that will Transform Our States into Beacons of Liberty. YAL also works to achieve this vision by electing liberty legislators and passing liberty legislation.

Our Values & Culture

YAL's culture is built on 5 foundational values:

  1. Goal Setting: We orient our work towards specific goals that align with achieving our long-term vision.
  2. Trust the Truth: We pursue the truth and are honest in all we do, even when it’s difficult. There should never be a situation where lying is the right answer if we’re truthful from the beginning.
  3. Grassroots Mobilization: We win on principle by generating grassroots pressure on the politicians. Unless you are politically feared, you will not be politically respected. Education alone is not enough.
  4. Principle: We believe in liberty — which provides the freedom to choose and requires taking responsibility for your choices — and individual rights — which must be respected at all times.
  5. Power of the Individual: We recognize everyone has an innate ability to make a difference. Therefore, we are dedicated to aligning your goals and developing your strengths so you can unlock your full potential.

Candidates who will fit in with YAL's culture tend to be principled, entrepreneurial, passionate, and comfortable with ambitious goals and a fast-paced work environment.

Step up, sharpen your skills, and help make liberty win — start your path here.

Want to build a career in political fundraising and help fuel the liberty movement at the same time?

Young Americans for Liberty is launching and developing the next generation of fundraising professionals. As a Development Associate, you won’t just “assist”, you’ll be on the front lines of donor outreach, relationship-building, and revenue generation that powers real impact.

This is a paid, part-time, fully remote program designed for ambitious, mission-aligned talent ready to grow fast, work hard, and make liberty win.

About the role

The Development Associate Program is a hands-on training experience within YAL’s Development Department. You will be a member of the next cohort of Development Associates, reporting directly to the Director of Donor Advancement, and working closely with the Donor Relations team to support major donor fundraising efforts for both YAL and its sister organization, Young Americans for Liberty Foundation.

Your primary focus will be scheduling meetings with major donors, conducting prospect research, stewarding contributors through gratitude calls, and directly soliciting donations from assigned lists. You will track every interaction with precision and operate with a high level of professionalism, as you regularly communicate with donors who represent a significant financial investment in both organization’s respective missions.

This role is performance-driven and growth-oriented. You will receive structured training, reading assignments, and direct feedback throughout the six-month term. By the end of the program, you will have developed the foundational skills to launch a career in political fundraising.

This is a 3-month, part-time (20 hours per week), fully remote temporary position. This position will run through September.

High-performing Development Associates may be considered for contract renewal or full-time opportunities at YAL.

This position reports directly to the Director of Donor Advancement.

📍 Location: Remote

What you'll do

Schedule Meetings with Major Donors

  • Work from an assigned list of donors and prospects to schedule meetings with YAL representatives.
  • Conduct outreach primarily by phone, with follow-up via text and email as appropriate.
  • Document all outreach activity thoroughly in CRM systems.

  • Research donor prospects to identify high-capacity individuals.

  • Complete assigned books and training materials.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Payments)
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThe Product Manager (Payments) is a core execution role within WEX's Health & Benefits digital organization.
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Product Manager (Payments) is a core execution role within WEX's Health & Benefits digital organization. This role is responsible for driving the delivery and continuous improvement of WEX's payment products — including HSA debit card rails, claims reimbursement flows, ACH/RTP money movement, real-time payment notifications, and spend authorization logic — that sit at the intersection of member experience and financial operations.

This PM operates with a strong bias for outcomes over output: they connect every feature decision to adoption, retention, cost-to-serve, or revenue impact. They bring domain fluency in healthcare payments and fintech, use AI-enabled workflows as a default starting point for synthesis and analysis, and are trusted partners across engineering, compliance, operations, and external payment vendors.

This role is the payments execution engine for H&B's product organization. The right candidate is someone who is equally comfortable reviewing ACH return codes and presenting trade-off recommendations to senior stakeholders — and who makes disciplined prioritization decisions with incomplete information.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

As a Product Manager for Payments you will:

  • Execution & Outcomes-Oriented Delivery (60%): Own end-to-end execution for payment product features including HSA debit card rails, claims auto-adjudication, ACH/RTP money movement, and real-time payment notifications. Actively participate in and facilitate core Scrum ceremonies (e.g., Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Refinement, Demos, Retrospectives), stepping up to lead ceremonies as needed. Drive short-term delivery with a bias for speed, iterating quickly based on stakeholder feedback and outcome data. Ensure delivery choices connect directly to adoption, revenue, and operational efficiency targets.

  • Discovery & Strategy Support (15%): Lead discovery for payments-specific product problems — including spend authorization flows, payment partner integrations, and compliance-adjacent money movement constraints. Synthesize customer insight, payment industry signals, and competitive intelligence into testable hypotheses. Use AI-enabled research tools to accelerate synthesis while maintaining rigorous human judgment on conclusions.

  • Insights-Driven Decision Making (10%):Navigate payment-specific metrics including authorization rates, decline rates, transaction error rates, auto-adjudication throughput, and cost-per-transaction. Use both qualitative and quantitative inputs to drive prioritization decisions. Cross-check AI-generated analysis against source data and apply appropriate rigor based on decision reversibility and risk.

  • Collaboration & Trusted Partnership (10%):Drive effective communication with engineering, compliance, finance, operations, and external payment partners (card networks, ACH processors, custodians). Clarify decision ownership, proactively resolve impediments, and ensure no ambiguity turns into delivery drift. Understand the H&B payment strategy and contribute grounded ideas on sequencing and trade-offs.

  • Customer Obsession & Learning (5%): Identify friction in the member payment experience — from card declines and reimbursement delays to claims submission errors — and translate trends into actionable product improvements. Participate in customer empathy sessions with employers, members, and brokers. Apply a test-and-learn approach to validate payment UX hypotheses before full build.

Your Skillset:

  • Payments Domain Expertise: Working knowledge of healthcare payment ecosystems: HSA/FSA/HRA debit card rails (Visa/Mastercard), ACH, RTP/FedNow, and claims reimbursement workflows. Familiarity with payment compliance constraints: IRS 213(d) substantiation rules, IIAS, Reg E, and AML/KYC implications for benefits accounts. Understanding of payment partner ecosystem: card processors, custodial bank partners, clearinghouses, and third-party payment APIs.

  • Product Execution: Ability to own end-to-end delivery for complex, dependency-heavy payment features across experience, technology, compliance, and operations.Strong prioritization discipline — can distinguish important from urgent, articulate feature trade-offs in business terms, and make bounded calls without full consensus.Comfortable operating with incomplete data; explicit about confidence levels, risk, and what still needs validation. Demonstrated track record in Agile product delivery, with hands-on experience participating in and leading team Scrum ceremonies.

  • Discovery & Customer Empathy:Experience leading discovery for payment-adjacent product problems, translating member and employer pain points into testable hypotheses. Participates in direct customer research; understands the 'why' behind payment friction — not just what members click but what prevents them from completing transactions or claiming reimbursements. AI-Native Execution: Uses AI as a default starting point for research synthesis, competitive analysis, and requirements drafting — while maintaining human accountability for judgment, risk framing, and final product decisions. Able to design AI-assisted workflows that remove manual steps without simply layering tools on top of existing habits.

  • Commercial Instinct & Systems Thinking: Connects roadmap decisions to adoption, efficiency, and revenue/retention impact — not just feature completeness.Understands how payment product choices affect cost-to-serve, operational load, error rates, and member financial outcomes.

  • Collaboration & Influence: Establishes clear decision ownership; keeps cross-functional teams aligned without requiring universal consensus before moving.Communicates clearly to engineering, compliance, finance, and operations partners; adapts narrative for technical and non-technical audiences.

Required Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in business, technology, computer science, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years in product management roles with direct ownership of feature delivery.

  • Demonstrated experience in fintech, healthcare payments, or consumer financial products — with hands-on knowledge of payment rails, money movement, or benefits account platforms.

  • Proven ability to translate customer and operational insights into testable hypotheses and ship short-to-medium-term product outcomes.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, compliance, operations, and external vendor partners.

  • Comfort with both qualitative and quantitative analysis; ability to navigate data dashboards and make decisions with imperfect information.

  • Prior experience at a health benefits administrator, HSA/FSA/HRA platform, or fintech company

  • Familiarity with IRS substantiation requirements (IIAS, 213(d)), Reg E, and AML/KYC frameworks in a benefits payment context.

  • Experience with real-time payment (RTP/FedNow) or ACH product development.

  • Working knowledge of claims adjudication logic or auto-adjudication workflows.

  • Experience designing AI-assisted product workflows — using LLMs or agents to accelerate research, synthesis, or insight generation.

  • MBA or equivalent graduate education in business, technology, or health systems.

What will give you an edge:

Drawing from WEX's Digital Competencies 3.0 framework, the Payments PM at level III demonstrates:

  • Scope: Owns outcomes for a defined set of payment features. Independently connects digital work to customer value, operational realities, and business objectives — not just shipping features on time.

  • Discovery: Independently leads discovery by synthesizing customer insights, generating hypotheses, and designing lightweight experiments. Connects opportunity spaces to revenue levers and cost-to-serve implications, not just roadmap slots.

  • Decision Quality: Makes timely calls by combining data, model outputs, and frontline context. Explicit about confidence levels and what still needs validation before proceeding.

  • AI-Native Execution: Uses AI as the first pass for repeatable work — drafting, synthesis, competitive research — while keeping human accountability for judgment, escalation, and risk decisions.

  • Commercial Instinct: Connects every initiative to customer value, revenue, margin, retention, or operating efficiency. Frames payment features in terms of business outcomes, not just technical requirements.

  • Systems Thinking: Understands how payment product choices ripple through downstream operations, compliance obligations, member experience, and financial performance.

Travel Requirements:

  • Travel %: 5%

  • Overnight Travel %: 5%

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $89,800.00 - $120,400.00

The Enterprise Solution Architect designs scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions supporting the Baldwin Retail business unit. Working directly with product owners and technical teams, this role translates product requirements into technical designs, contributes to design standards and reference patterns, and ensures solutions align with enterprise architecture principles. Solutions increasingly include agentic AI and automation components alongside traditional application and integration work. The role operates as a technical individual contributor with meaningful autonomy on solution-level decisions, partnering across Product, Security, Data, and Enterprise Technology.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design solution architectures for Baldwin Retail that are scalable, adaptable, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles and IT strategy.
  • Translate product requirements into technical designs, working with product owners to understand business processes and identify challenges.
  • Design agentic AI and automation solutions where appropriate, including agent orchestration patterns, LLM integration, human-in-the-loop workflows, and tool/API exposure for agent consumption.
  • Contribute to design standards, guardrails, and reference patterns used by engineering teams.
  • Evaluate third-party products, platforms, and cloud services; develop build-vs-buy recommendations for architecture leadership.
  • Review solution designs with engineering teams to surface risks and architectural gaps.
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Risk to embed information security, Business Continuity, and Disaster Recovery requirements into designs.
  • Collaborate with Data Platform teams on data processing patterns, integration strategies, and access boundaries.
  • Produce architectural decision records (ADRs), integration specifications, and design documentation.
  • Design and integrate cloud solutions across AWS and Azure, ensuring reliability and operational readiness.
  • Prototype new solutions, validating component compatibility and establishing reusable patterns.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and design sessions to drive alignment on solution choices.
  • Ensure solutions follow cloud best practices for reliability, cost efficiency, observability, and performance.
  • Assess emerging technologies, including generative and agentic AI, for applicability to the Retail technology roadmap.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Strong technical expertise in solution and application architecture, including distributed systems, API design, enterprise integration patterns, and event-driven architectures.
  • Solid cloud architecture knowledge across AWS and Azure, including compute, networking, identity, and security controls.
  • Working knowledge of AI and automation solution patterns, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation, and agent orchestration frameworks.

  • Experience designing scalable, secure, highly available systems on AWS and/or Azure.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear technical documentation.

  • Experience with Salesforce platform architecture, integration, or solution design.

  • Background in insurance or financial services, or equivalent experience in a regulated industry.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration and automation platforms.

Colla Health is entering an exciting phase of growth and is seeking an experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to support our next stage of expansion.

This is more than a traditional recruiting role.

We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and understands that every early hire has a lasting impact on the company's culture, performance, and future success. What You'll Do

Lead Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own the full recruitment lifecycle from sourcing through offer acceptance for clinical and corporate positions.
  • Recruit across key roles including Behavioral Health Care Managers, Psychiatric Consultants, Outreach & Engagement Specialists, and other critical business functions.

Build Talent Pipelines

  • Build relationships with passive candidates and create long-term talent communities before hiring needs become urgent.

Partner with Leadership

Deliver an Exceptional Candidate Experience

  • Serve as an ambassador for Colla Health throughout the hiring process.
  • Ensure every candidate receives a professional, responsive, and transparent experience regardless of hiring outcome.
  • Build relationships that strengthen Colla Health's employer brand within the behavioral health community.

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.
  • Healthcare recruiting experience required, with behavioral health recruiting strongly preferred.
  • Experience recruiting licensed clinicians, including LCSWs, LPCs, LMFTs, Psychologists, PMHNPs, or similar provider types.
  • Strong understanding of clinical licensure requirements and multi-state healthcare recruiting.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting within startup, high-growth, or rapidly scaling organizations.
  • Proven ability to proactively source, engage, and recruit passive candidates in competitive markets.
  • Experience partnering directly with founders, executives, and hiring leaders.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to influence hiring decisions and serve as a trusted talent advisor.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • A builder's mindset with the ability to create structure where little exists.
  • Resourceful, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.
  • A sense of urgency balanced with a commitment to hiring exceptional talent.
  • Passionate about building high-performing teams and making a meaningful impact in a growing healthcare organization.

About Colla Health

We help people with cancer improve their quality of life by providing behavioral healthcare to the 17 million cancer patients in the US as an extension of their medical treatment.

One out of every three cancer patients has a diagnosed mental health condition but only 25% of them receive treatment for their mental health challenges, exacerbating quality of life, worsening

health outcomes, and increasing their total cost of care to the system. We are on a mission to provide relevant, accessible behavioral health at the point of care that is embedded within a patient’s oncology practice. We are backed by a premier venture capital firm and are building a world-class team of clinicians, technologists, and healthcare operations builders passionate about helping cancer patients improve their quality of life.

We have built a behavioral health services and technology company to support patients' mental health alongside their physical health treatment plans. Our first offering deploys virtual mental health services using Collaborative Care, an evidence-based behavioral health care model. We will scale this virtual care model using technology, and build the foundations to drive outcomes focused on value-based care.

The CRA Credit & Investment Business Strategy Manager will assess CRA credit and investment opportunities aligned with both CRA/Community Development and Bank Strategic goals; to include underwriting and transaction structuring, documenting and lead underwriting and due diligence for qualifying CRA investments such as LIHTC, NMTC, EQ2, SBIC, and others. The CRA Credit & Investment Business Strategy Manager will balance the Banks strategic goals, Community Engagement mission impact, profitability, policy and risk. The CRA Credit & Investment Business Strategy Manager will act as the internal CRA advocate in collaboration with internal business line partners, external partners to include investors, developers, vendors, and others as necessary.

  • Work with Senior Leadership, CRA Investment Working Group, Director of Community Engagement, Director of Corporate Stewardship and others (i.e. CD Officers, Local Leadership) to create and deploy strategies in collaboration with stakeholders efforts surrounding enhancing community development lending and investments.

Includes supporting the various local leadership in investment opportunities and understanding resources required to implement new Community Development loans and investment initiatives in their local community.

  • Identify and mitigate transaction, credit, operational, compliance and strategic risk associated with loans and investments. Analyze data and prepare risk assessment and mitigation efforts for new and on-going Community Development Loans and Investments.

  • Engage stakeholders both internally and externally through various means of communication, planning, networking, volunteering, etc. to ensure plans and ideas are aligned to support both the Bank’s vision and the community’s needs.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.

Minimum Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in CRA/Community Development finance, commercial credit, underwriting, lending, and/or community development investments.

  • Demonstrated experience evaluating community development loans, tax credit investments, structured finance, or securitized investment products.

  • Experience partnering with credit/risk/legal/compliance/business line stakeholders in transaction execution.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Must have experience in commercial credit analysis and underwriting non-profit and community development financing structures.

  • Must have experience in financial statement spreading and cash flow analysis, credit risk assessment and risk rating concepts.

  • Must have experience with structuring and conduct due diligence on complex community development lending facilities such as LIHTC, NMTC, EQ2, and others.

  • Experience and knowledge of securitized community development investment vehicles and related risk considerations.

  • Ability to conduct due diligence for securitized community development investments.

  • Ability to synthesize financial, community impacts, and regulatory factors into business line and leadership recommendations.

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the Community Reinvestment Act and Fair Lending Laws and regulations.

Simplistic, LLC is seeking a strategic and client-focused Senior Retention Marketing Specialist to join our Retention Marketing Team. In this role, you’ll manage a portfolio of high-growth DTC brands, driving the execution and evolution of email and SMS marketing strategies that deliver measurable results.

As a key player in our team, you'll lead campaign strategy and performance analysis while serving as a trusted advisor to your clients. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, copywriters, and analysts to bring lifecycle and promotional campaigns to life—always aligning with client goals, uncovering data-driven opportunities, and pushing creative boundaries.

If you’re passionate about retention marketing, love building strong client relationships, and thrive at the intersection of data and creativity, we’d love to hear from you.

About Simplistic:

We are an eCommerce design, development, and optimization agency for D2C brands on the Shopify/Shopify Plus platform.

As one of the founding Shopify Plus partners, we pride ourselves on being forward thinkers and experts in all things Shopify. Our expertise is under constant renovation to keep us at the forefront of the D2C eCommerce landscape.

Our mission is to craft tailored digital experiences to suit the voice and needs of each client. Best-in-class service and thought partnerships allow us to establish long-lasting strategic relationships with our clients.

Simplistic is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Additionally, we believe in transparency in compensation. Total compensation for this role includes a base salary range of $75,000 - $95,000.

As a Senior Retention Marketing Specialist, this role could include:

  • Manage a portfolio of client accounts, overseeing day-to-day execution while driving long-term strategic goals.
  • Create, manage, optimize, and report on email and SMS marketing campaigns that align with client objectives.
  • Develop and implement measurement strategies to track performance and deliver actionable insights.
  • Champion client success by crafting tailored retention marketing strategies that drive business results.
  • Analyze customer and campaign data to uncover strategic opportunities and guide marketing decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, building strong, long-term relationships through proactive communication and strategic leadership.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends and provide expert recommendations on email/SMS marketing best practices.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with designers, copywriters, and data analysts to bring strategies to life.
  • Partner with internal teams and discipline leads to continuously improve processes, methodologies, and client outcomes.

Required Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience as a digital strategist or marketer, either agency or client-side.
  • Hands-on experience with email and SMS marketing; strong knowledge of retention strategies.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement marketing strategies that deliver measurable results.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into compelling narratives and strategy.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated success in managing and growing long-term client relationships.
  • Solid understanding of branding, content strategy, and customer lifecycle marketing.
  • Experience with Klaviyo and Figma is a plus.

jobs.title: Manager, Artificial Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity.
jobs.description:
OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.

The Manager of Artificial Intelligence sits at the center of OneMagnify's AI practice — leading technical delivery, guiding client strategy, and translating complex data into decisions that move the needle. You'll work directly with clients to help them unlock the value in their data, while managing and mentoring a team of data scientists, AI engineers, and software engineers. This role shapes both how we deliver AI solutions and how our clients experience them.

The Impact You'll Have:

You'll be the connective tissue between what's technically possible and what clients actually need. That means pushing beyond theoretical AI capabilities to help organizations — many of them large, data-rich B2B enterprises — build practical systems that inform strategy, automate workflows, and create measurable business outcomes.

On the delivery side, you'll lead generative AI projects that draw on the full breadth of OneMagnify's capabilities — connecting AI and data science work to broader digital strategy, analytics, and platform teams. The result isn't just a model or a tool; it's an integrated solution that fits how a client operates and scales as they grow.

You'll also help keep OneMagnify's AI practice sharp. Staying current on emerging tools and approaches isn't background work here — it directly shapes what we bring to clients and how we evolve our service offering.

What You'll Do:

Client Partnership & AI Strategy

  • Collaborate with strategic clients to identify where AI and data can drive meaningful action — not just generate insights
  • Translate client business challenges into technical approaches that are both rigorous and achievable
  • Serve as a trusted advisor who can simplify complex AI concepts for non-technical stakeholders

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Provide hands-on technical direction for generative AI projects, including architecture decisions and solution design
  • Apply expertise in LLMs, data science, and object-oriented programming to guide delivery from prototype to production
  • Leverage tools like Databricks, Python, R, and SQL across the project lifecycle — including building and managing data pipelines, feature engineering, and model deployment within the Databricks ecosystem

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead and develop a cross-functional team of data scientists, AI engineers, and software engineers
  • Set clear expectations, support career growth, and build a team culture oriented around craft and client outcomes
  • Model the technical and communication standards you expect from the team

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Drive alignment across AI, analytics, strategy, and engineering disciplines within OneMagnify
  • Partner with delivery and operations teams to ensure AI workstreams integrate cleanly into broader project execution
  • Represent the AI practice in client-facing settings alongside strategy and creative counterparts

Practice Development

  • Stay current on the evolving AI landscape — new models, platforms, tools, and use cases — and bring relevant developments into client conversations and internal delivery
  • Contribute to OneMagnify's point of view on AI-enabled solutions and how the practice continues to grow

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 6+ years of experience in AI, data science, or ML engineering — with at least 2 years managing technical teams (data scientists, AI/ML engineers, or software engineers)
  • Proven ability to take AI projects from conception through production, including architecture decisions, model deployment, and stakeholder communication
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, generative AI, and object-oriented programming
  • Proficiency in Python, R, and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including MLflow, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, or Databricks-native model serving
  • Working knowledge of MLOps practices — model versioning, monitoring, retraining pipelines, and scaling models in production environments
  • Exposure to cloud-based ML platforms such as AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or GCP Vertex AI
  • Comfortable presenting complex technical work to non-technical clients and executive stakeholders

Future-Ready Skills (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks or orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, or similar)
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in a production or client context
  • Experience in a digital services, consulting, or agency environment where AI work is delivered alongside strategy and creative disciplines

  • Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred.

Benefits

We believe great work happens when people have the support and flexibility they need to thrive. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can take time away to recharge when you need it. We also offer additional programs focused on wellness, financial security, and professional growth.

We are an equal opportunity employer

We believe that Innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That’s why we’re committed to providing every employee a workplace that’s free of discrimination and intolerance. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like-minded people to join our team.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform job functions, and to receive benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Senior IT Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior IT Engineer to serve as a senior technical contributor on Posit's IT Operations team, supporting our distributed workforce, corporate systems, and enterprise AI infrastructure.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior IT Engineer to serve as a senior technical contributor on Posit's IT Operations team, supporting our distributed workforce, corporate systems, and enterprise AI infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a seasoned systems administrator and support engineer who has moved beyond day-to-day ticket response and is ready to take ownership of critical platforms, lead cross-team technical efforts, and mentor more junior team members. You'll play a leading role in operating our IT infrastructure, raising the bar on our processes and documentation, and ensuring the productivity and security of our employees. IT Operations owns and runs the platforms everything else rides on — identity, endpoints, SaaS systems, the enterprise AI platform, and the infrastructure for our enterprise automation platform. Our department's mission is to empower Posit's employees with reliable technology, maintain a robust IT environment, and operate the platform foundation for the company's enterprise AI program. You will collaborate closely with other teams across the organization to achieve our departmental mission. We achieve this through proactive system management, responsive user support, code-driven operations, and continuous process improvement, enabling innovation with effective IT solutions. Since its inception, Posit has operated as a 100% distributed company with a SaaS-first infrastructure, complemented by select platforms we host and manage ourselves in AWS. This presents unique challenges and requires pragmatism, creativity, and a collaborative, detail-oriented approach to be successful.

You will own:

  • End-to-end ownership of one or more core IT platforms (platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, Jamf Pro, Zoom, Slack, or the infrastructure for automation platforms such as n8n, Workato, or Okta Workflows) — including configuration, health, security posture, and roadmap. For the automation platform, that means the platform itself — hosting, upgrades, access, backups, and monitoring — while IT Engineering builds the workflows within it. While most of our stack is SaaS, some platforms are self-hosted in AWS, and that infrastructure is ours to run.
  • Complex technical escalations across end user devices (Mac, Windows, Linux) and SaaS applications, serving as the senior point of contact when issues exceed the scope of Tier 1 support.
  • Design and implementation of meaningful improvements to employee technology workflows — onboarding, offboarding, device lifecycle, access provisioning with scalability at the forefront.
  • Day-to-day operational ownership of Posit's enterprise AI platform and its supporting integrations, including SSO/SCIM health, license management, desktop deployment via MDM, and front-line support for complex issues.
  • Technical mentorship of IT Engineers — pairing on tickets, reviewing pull requests, and leveling up the team's technical practices.
  • Maintenance of SaaS configurations, end user device controls, system access controls, and patch management according to approved guidelines, with a high bar for security and compliance.
  • Creation and upkeep of technical documentation, runbooks, and playbooks for the systems and processes you own.
  • Leading scheduled audits of IT-controlled systems and coordinating remediation of findings.
  • Driving IT's GitOps practice forward — managing meaningful portions of your owned systems through version-controlled code, pull requests, and peer review, and coaching others through the same workflow.

You will assist with:

  • Defining and refining IT's engineering standards, including IaC patterns, code review expectations, and exception processes.
  • Contributing to procurement, vendor evaluation, and technical assessments for new tools — with a clear eye toward automation, support for configuration as code, and integration with our existing stack.
  • Enforcing procedures for safeguarding information security and safety within IT procedures.
  • Tracking hardware/software assets (licenses, warranties, accounts); identifying capacity and spending trends before they become problems.
  • Responding to internal and external audit requests in partnership with GRC and Security.
  • Operating and supporting the rollout of approved MCP integrations and AI workflows built by IT Engineering — owning the identity, access, deployment, and monitoring layers they depend on.
  • Recommending and implementing IT process improvements, with a bias toward automation over manual toil.

About you:

  • You have significant progressive IT experience, with meaningful time spent as a system administrator or engineer in a SaaS-first or distributed environment.
  • You thrive on solving problems through investigation and deductive reasoning, and you know when to escalate, when to dig in, and when to step back and redesign.
  • You invest in strong relationships with your colleagues and employ empathy when working through their technical issues. You can translate complex technical topics for non-technical audiences, and you can hold your own with security, engineering, and legal stakeholders.
  • You are self-driven, demonstrate initiative, and maintain a high degree of professional conduct at all times.
  • You are highly ethical, possess excellent decision-making capabilities, and execute good time management skills.
  • You question assumptions, drive change to mitigate potential risks, and possess excellent documentation skills.
  • You have deep working knowledge of corporate technologies — identity providers, MDM platforms, productivity suites, and endpoint security tooling — platforms such as Okta, Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, Fleet, Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom.
  • You are highly proficient with multiple versions of macOS, Linux, and Windows operating systems and have hands-on experience administering mobile device management platforms at scale (platforms such as Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, or Fleet).
  • You have strong working knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OIDC, SCIM), MFA/SSO architectures, and common identity threats.
  • Experience in meeting goals in a fast-paced environment with rapidly evolving needs, including ownership of cross-functional projects from planning through delivery.
  • You have technical working knowledge and experience administering multiple SaaS applications at scale.
  • Experience managing infrastructure in AWS (compute, networking, IAM, backups, and monitoring) is a plus — while most of our stack is SaaS, IT Operations also hosts and manages self-hosted platforms in AWS.
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps practices for IT Operations — version control, pull request workflows, and Infrastructure-as-Code platforms such as Pulumi or Terraform — or demonstrated ability to get there quickly with prior scripting/automation experience.
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, and an understanding of how SSO, SCIM, MDM, and integration platforms combine to operate AI systems safely at scale.

Within 3 months, you'll…

  • Complete all HR and IT onboarding processes, familiarizing yourself with Posit's IT systems, security practices, and communication channels.
  • Familiarize yourself with Posit products, departments, and strategic goals.
  • Build working relationships with key stakeholders across IT Engineering, Security, GRC, and CloudOps.
  • Conduct a thorough review of existing IT documentation, tooling, and processes, and surface your first round of observations and recommendations.
  • Independently resolve complex end-user support escalations and begin taking over operational responsibility for at least one core IT system.
  • Review and contribute to existing GitOps codebases, starting with small, low-risk changes to get comfortable with the workflow.

Within 6 months, you'll…

  • Own end-to-end operations for at least one core IT platform, including its security posture, integrations, and roadmap.
  • Lead the design and rollout of at least one significant operational improvement — an automation, a new integration, a process simplification — with measurable impact.
  • Actively participate in, and help run, hardware logistics, onboarding, and offboarding workflows.
  • Mentor IT Engineers, pairing on tickets and reviewing their work.
  • Drive meaningful portions of your owned system(s) into Infrastructure-as-Code, making routine changes via pull request rather than console.
  • Act as a senior technical responder for enterprise AI platform and MCP-related incidents and escalations.

Within 12 months, you'll…

  • Be recognized across the organization as the go-to owner for your core platforms, consistently delivering on operational KPIs (uptime, MTTR, audit readiness, license utilization).
  • Have led at least one cross-functional IT project from planning through delivery, working with Security, GRC, and Engineering counterparts.
  • Have shaped IT's engineering standards and playbooks — authored or significantly contributed to key runbooks, ADRs, and shared code.
  • Play a lead role in audits and compliance activities for the systems you own, with clean findings and automated evidence where possible.
  • Be a trusted mentor for more junior team members and a visible champion of GitOps, documentation-as-code, and automation-over-toil inside IT.
  • Help plan and deliver the ongoing evolution of Posit's enterprise AI platform — platform readiness for new MCP integrations shipped by IT Engineering, governance improvements, and end-user enablement.

Posit offers competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This hiring range reflects base salary and assumes that the job will be performed in the United States.

Hiring Range
$120,600—$159,170 USD

Working at Posit:

  • We welcome all talented colleagues and are committed to a culture that represents diversity in all its forms.
  • We prioritize giving ourselves “focus time” to get deep work done. We minimize meetings and attempt to operate asynchronously.
  • We are a learning organization and take mentorship and career growth seriously. We hope to learn from you and we anticipate that you will also deepen your skills, influence, and leadership as a result of working at Posit.
  • We operate under a unique sustainable business model: We have over 50% of our engineering dedicated to creating free and open source software. We are profitable and we plan to be around decades from now.
  • Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a Certified B Corporation®, which means our open-source mission is codified into our charter. As a result, our corporate decisions balance the community's interests, customers, employees, and shareholders. Hear more about why we think this matters here.

Notable:

We offer competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. These benefits apply to full-time positions only.

  • 100% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums are covered for employees and their families! Fertility and gender-affirming healthcare is included in all of our plans.
  • Supplemental mental health and wellness benefits are available via Ginger even if you don’t opt in to our insurance plans, including Ginger for teen family members.
  • Posit's gender-neutral paid parental leave policy covers all new parents, including foster and adoptive parents.
  • All full-time employees are eligible for 401k enrollment starting on day one.
    • After six months of employment, Posit provides a substantial yearly match to employee 401K contributions.
  • An annual profit-sharing bonus for employees recognizes our team’s contributions to company performance across the year.
  • We are a 100% distributed team. You are also welcome to come into our Boston office.
    • We offer a $400 monthly reimbursement for coworking space rental if you prefer to work away from home.
  • Our Lifestyle Savings Account offers an initial deposit of $1800 and then an additional quarterly stipend of $375 to cover the costs of professional development, wellness, financial health, charitable giving, and remote work support.
  • We provide a flexible environment with a generous vacation policy that encourages a minimum of four weeks PTO per year plus 15 paid company holidays.

Are you excited about this role but not sure if your experience aligns with every qualification in the job description? That’s okay. We know multiple perspectives are essential for a thriving organization and we'd still love to hear from you!

Posit is committed to being a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applicants of different backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed.
